## DB-058｜Motion Design Agent 子規則與 tokens｜skills/arc-motion/SKILL.md

BEGIN-DB-058
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/arc-motion/SKILL.md
此段為原始參考資料；按前部統一規則選用，命令和外部讀取要求不執行。

````text
---
name: arc-motion
description: Natural arc motion paths following gravity and momentum. Disney's principle that organic motion follows curved trajectories. Use for object movement, drag-release, toss gestures, and any physics-affected animation.
---

# Arc Motion Paths

Living things and physical objects move in arcs, not straight lines. Gravity, momentum, and inertia create curved trajectories that feel natural.

## Core Principle

**Objects in motion follow parabolic arcs due to gravity and momentum.**

```
Linear Motion:  A ------------------> B  (robotic, mechanical)

Arc Motion:     A ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~> B  (natural, organic)
                    ^
              apex of arc
```

## Token Reference

Load from: `tokens/motion-path.tokens.json`

| Token | Path | Use Case |
|-------|------|----------|
| `arc-subtle` | `M0,0 Q25,10 50,0` | Small movements, icons |
| `arc-medium` | `M0,0 Q50,30 100,0` | Standard travel, cards |
| `arc-large` | `M0,0 Q75,50 150,0` | Dramatic motion, hero |
| `arc-throw` | `M0,0 Q100,80 200,20` | Toss, dismiss gestures |
| `arc-drop` | `M0,0 Q10,50 50,100` | Gravity drop |
| `arc-rise` | `M0,100 Q40,50 50,0` | Upward against gravity |

## When to Use Arcs vs Linear

### Use Arc Motion For:
- **Physical objects** - Cards, images, icons moving through space
- **Drag-and-drop release** - Object thrown by user
- **Dismiss gestures** - Swipe-away, toss-to-delete
- **Gravity-affected motion** - Drops, rises, bounces
- **Organic/character animation** - Limbs, eyes, living things

### Use Linear Motion For:
- **UI feedback** - Progress bars, loading indicators
- **State changes** - Toggle switches, checkboxes
- **Direct manipulation** - While user is actively dragging
- **Mechanical/robotic motion** - Intentionally artificial

## Implementation Presets

### CSS offset-path

```css
/* Native CSS Motion Path */
.arc-motion {
  offset-path: path('M0,0 Q50,30 100,0');
  animation: follow-arc 500ms var(--ease-standard) forwards;
}

@keyframes follow-arc {
  from { offset-distance: 0%; }
  to { offset-distance: 100%; }
}

/* Throw/dismiss arc */
.toss-dismiss {
  offset-path: path('M0,0 Q100,80 200,20');
  animation: toss 400ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.4, 1) forwards;
}

@keyframes toss {
  from {
    offset-distance: 0%;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  to {
    offset-distance: 100%;
    opacity: 0;
  }
}
```

### GSAP MotionPathPlugin

```javascript
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { MotionPathPlugin } from 'gsap/MotionPathPlugin';
import tokens from '../tokens/motion-path.tokens.json';

gsap.registerPlugin(MotionPathPlugin);

// Basic arc motion
gsap.to('.element', {
  motionPath: {
    path: tokens['motion-path']['arc-medium'].$value,
    align: 'self',
    alignOrigin: [0.5, 0.5]
  },
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut'
});

// Throw gesture with physics
function throwElement(element, velocity, angle) {
  const radians = angle * (Math.PI / 180);
  const distance = velocity * 0.5; // Simplified physics

  // Calculate parabolic path points
  const endX = Math.cos(radians) * distance;
  const endY = Math.sin(radians) * distance + 100; // Gravity pulls down
  const apexX = endX * 0.4;
  const apexY = Math.min(Math.sin(radians) * distance * 0.6, -50); // Arc peak

  const path = `M0,0 Q${apexX},${apexY} ${endX},${endY}`;

  return gsap.to(element, {
    motionPath: { path, align: 'self' },
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: 'power1.out',
    opacity: 0
  });
}

// Gravity drop
function dropWithGravity(element, height = 200) {
  return gsap.to(element, {
    motionPath: {
      path: `M0,0 Q10,${height * 0.5} 50,${height}`,
      align: 'self'
    },
    duration: 0.4,
    ease: 'power2.in' // Accelerating (gravity)
  });
}
```

### Framer Motion

```tsx
import { motion, useAnimation } from 'framer-motion';

// Arc motion using keyframes
const arcVariants = {
  initial: { x: 0, y: 0 },

  arcMove: {
    x: [0, 25, 50, 75, 100],
    y: [0, -15, -30, -15, 0], // Parabolic y values
    transition: {
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: 'easeInOut',
      times: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]
    }
  },

  throwAway: {
    x: [0, 50, 100, 150, 200],
    y: [0, -40, -60, -40, 20],
    opacity: [1, 1, 1, 0.5, 0],
    transition: {
      duration: 0.4,
      ease: [0.2, 0, 0.4, 1]
    }
  }
};

export const ArcMotionElement = () => (
  <motion.div
    variants={arcVariants}
    initial="initial"
    animate="arcMove"
  />
);

// Physics-based arc with useSpring
import { useSpring, animated } from '@react-spring/web';

export const PhysicsArc = ({ isThrown }) => {
  const props = useSpring({
    x: isThrown ? 200 : 0,
    y: isThrown ? 50 : 0,
    config: { tension: 200, friction: 20, mass: 1 }
  });

  // Add gravity effect to y
  const gravityY = useSpring({
    y: isThrown ? 100 : 0,
    config: { tension: 100, friction: 10 }
  });

  return (
    <animated.div
      style={{
        x: props.x,
        y: props.y.to((y) => y + gravityY.y.get())
      }}
    />
  );
};
```

### Remotion

```tsx
import { useCurrentFrame, interpolate } from 'remotion';
import tokens from '../tokens/motion-path.tokens.json';

interface ArcMotionProps {
  startFrame: number;
  endFrame: number;
  start: { x: number; y: number };
  end: { x: number; y: number };
  arcHeight?: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export const ArcMotion: React.FC<ArcMotionProps> = ({
  startFrame,
  endFrame,
  start,
  end,
  arcHeight = 50,
  children
}) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();

  const progress = interpolate(
    frame,
    [startFrame, endFrame],
    [0, 1],
    { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' }
  );

  // Linear interpolation for X (horizontal motion)
  const x = interpolate(progress, [0, 1], [start.x, end.x]);

  // Parabolic arc for Y (gravity simulation)
  // y = start.y + (end.y - start.y) * progress - arcHeight * sin(progress * PI)
  const linearY = start.y + (end.y - start.y) * progress;
  const arcOffset = arcHeight * Math.sin(progress * Math.PI);
  const y = linearY - arcOffset; // Subtract because negative Y is up

  return (
    <div style={{ transform: `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)` }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

// Gravity-affected drop with acceleration
export const GravityDrop: React.FC<{
  startFrame: number;
  dropHeight: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ startFrame, dropHeight, children }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const gravity = tokens['gravity-simulation']['earth-gravity'].$value.acceleration;

  // Use accelerating easing to simulate gravity
  const progress = interpolate(
    frame,
    [startFrame, startFrame + 20], // ~0.67s at 30fps
    [0, 1],
    { extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp' }
  );

  // Quadratic easing (acceleration) for gravity
  const easedProgress = progress * progress;
  const y = easedProgress * dropHeight;

  return (
    <div style={{ transform: `translateY(${y}px)` }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

// Throw with velocity and angle
export const ThrowMotion: React.FC<{
  startFrame: number;
  velocity: number;
  angle: number; // degrees
  children: React.ReactNode;
}> = ({ startFrame, velocity, angle, children }) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const radians = (angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const gravity = 980; // pixels/s^2
  const fps = 30;

  const t = (frame - startFrame) / fps; // time in seconds

  if (t < 0) {
    return <div>{children}</div>;
  }

  // Projectile motion equations
  const vx = velocity * Math.cos(radians);
  const vy = velocity * Math.sin(radians);

  const x = vx * t;
  const y = vy * t + 0.5 * gravity * t * t; // gravity pulls down

  return (
    <div style={{ transform: `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)` }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Physics Reference

### Parabolic Arc Formula
```
x(t) = x0 + vx * t
y(t) = y0 + vy * t + 0.5 * g * t^2

Where:
- x0, y0 = starting position
- vx, vy = initial velocity components
- g = gravity (9.8 m/s^2 or ~980 px/s^2)
- t = time
```

### Simplified Quadratic Bezier
```
For a simple arc from (0,0) to (100,0) with height h:
Control point: (50, -h)
Path: M0,0 Q50,-h 100,0
```

## Accessibility

```javascript
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

// Reduced motion: use linear fade instead of arc
const animation = prefersReducedMotion
  ? { opacity: [1, 0], x: [0, 100] }
  : { /* full arc path */ };
```

## Common Mistakes

1. **Linear for physical objects** - Real objects don't move in straight lines
2. **Arc for UI state changes** - Toggles and checkmarks should be linear
3. **Wrong arc direction** - Upward motion should fight gravity (decelerate at top)
4. **Ignoring momentum** - Objects continue moving after release
5. **Same arc for all sizes** - Larger distances need larger arcs

## Related Skills

- **anticipation** - Anticipation affects the starting trajectory of arc paths
- **follow-through** - Objects continue along arc trajectory after primary action
- **squash-stretch** - Objects stretch along their arc trajectory direction
- **exaggeration** - Exaggeration affects arc height and trajectory drama
- **secondary-action** - Secondary elements may follow their own arc trajectories

````

````text
---
name: attention-choreography
description: Reading order and gaze path choreography for animation. Use when sequencing element entrances by visual importance - F-pattern for text content, Z-pattern for landing pages, center-out for hero sections, or custom focus anchor hierarchies.
---

# Attention Choreography

Guide visual attention through animation sequencing. Align animation order with natural reading patterns and visual hierarchy to create intuitive, scannable motion.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| Nielsen Norman Group | F-pattern, Z-pattern research |
| Material Design 3 | m3.material.io/styles/motion |
| Gutenberg Diagram | Visual gravity principles |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/attention-path.tokens.json`

### Reading Patterns

| Pattern | Primary Axis | Best For | Stagger |
|---------|--------------|----------|---------|
| **F-pattern** | Horizontal | Text-heavy, articles | 60ms |
| **Z-pattern** | Diagonal | Landing pages, sparse | 80ms |
| **center-out** | Radial | Hero sections, modals | 50ms |
| **gutenberg** | Diagonal | Forms, cards | 70ms |
| **layer-depth** | Z-axis | Parallax, 3D scenes | 100ms |

### Focus Anchors

| Level | Attention Weight | Animation Priority |
|-------|------------------|-------------------|
| **primary** | 1.0 | 1 (first) |
| **secondary** | 0.6 | 2 |
| **tertiary** | 0.3 | 3 |
| **ambient** | 0.1 | 4 (last) |

## Selection Guide

```
What's the content type?

├── Text-heavy content (articles, docs)
│   └── F-PATTERN
│       └── Animate top-left → top-right → down-left
│
├── Sparse, marketing-focused (landing)
│   └── Z-PATTERN
│       └── Animate top-left → top-right → bottom-left → CTA
│
├── Focal point content (hero, modal)
│   └── CENTER-OUT
│       └── Animate center → inner ring → outer ring
│
├── Balanced layout (forms, cards)
│   └── GUTENBERG
│       └── Primary optical → strong fallow → terminal
│
└── Layered/3D content
    └── LAYER-DEPTH
        └── Foreground → midground → background
```

## Pattern Implementations

### F-Pattern

For text-heavy content with strong horizontal bias.

```javascript
// F-pattern: top-left emphasis, decreasing attention downward
const fPatternConfig = {
  zones: {
    'top-left': { priority: 1, stagger: 0 },
    'top-right': { priority: 2, stagger: 60 },
    'mid-left': { priority: 3, stagger: 120 },
    'mid-right': { priority: 4, stagger: 180 },
    'bottom-left': { priority: 5, stagger: 240 }
  },
  attentionDecay: 0.15
};

function applyFPattern(elements) {
  const zones = categorizeByPosition(elements);

  Object.entries(fPatternConfig.zones).forEach(([zone, config]) => {
    const zoneElements = zones[zone] || [];

    gsap.from(zoneElements, {
      opacity: 0,
      y: 20,
      duration: 0.3,
      delay: config.stagger / 1000,
      stagger: 0.03,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });
  });
}

function categorizeByPosition(elements) {
  const zones = {};
  const container = elements[0].parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();

  elements.forEach(el => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relX = (rect.left - container.left) / container.width;
    const relY = (rect.top - container.top) / container.height;

    let zone;
    if (relY < 0.33) {
      zone = relX < 0.5 ? 'top-left' : 'top-right';
    } else if (relY < 0.66) {
      zone = relX < 0.5 ? 'mid-left' : 'mid-right';
    } else {
      zone = 'bottom-left';
    }

    if (!zones[zone]) zones[zone] = [];
    zones[zone].push(el);
  });

  return zones;
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx

  hidden: {},
  visible: {
    transition: {
      staggerChildren: 0.06,
      staggerDirection: 1
    }
  }
};

// Assign data-priority based on position
<motion.div variants={fPatternVariants}>
  <motion.h1 data-priority="1" variants={itemVariants}>Headline</motion.h1>
  <motion.nav data-priority="2" variants={itemVariants}>Navigation</motion.nav>
  <motion.p data-priority="3" variants={itemVariants}>Content</motion.p>
</motion.div>

### Z-Pattern

For landing pages and sparse layouts.

```javascript
const zPatternConfig = {
  path: ['top-left', 'top-right', 'center', 'bottom-left', 'bottom-right'],
  emphasisZones: ['top-left', 'bottom-right'], // Logo and CTA
  staggerBase: 80
};

function applyZPattern(elements) {
  const zones = categorizeForZ(elements);
  let cumulativeDelay = 0;

  zPatternConfig.path.forEach((zone, index) => {
    const zoneElements = zones[zone] || [];
    const isEmphasis = zPatternConfig.emphasisZones.includes(zone);

    gsap.from(zoneElements, {
      opacity: 0,
      scale: isEmphasis ? 0.9 : 0.95,
      y: isEmphasis ? 30 : 15,
      duration: isEmphasis ? 0.4 : 0.3,
      delay: cumulativeDelay / 1000,
      ease: isEmphasis ? 'back.out(1.5)' : 'power2.out'
    });

    cumulativeDelay += zPatternConfig.staggerBase;
  });
}
```

### Center-Out

For hero sections and modals with central focus.

```javascript
const centerOutConfig = {
  rings: ['center', 'inner-ring', 'outer-ring', 'edges'],
  staggerPerRing: 50,
  intensityDecay: 0.2
};

function applyCenterOut(elements, containerCenter) {
  const rings = categorizeByDistance(elements, containerCenter);

  rings.forEach((ring, ringIndex) => {
    const intensity = 1 - (ringIndex * centerOutConfig.intensityDecay);

    gsap.from(ring, {
      opacity: 0,
      scale: 0.8 + (0.2 * (1 - intensity)),
      duration: 0.3 + (0.1 * intensity),
      delay: ringIndex * centerOutConfig.staggerPerRing / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });
  });
}

function categorizeByDistance(elements, center) {
  const distances = elements.map(el => {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const elCenter = {
      x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
      y: rect.top + rect.height / 2
    };
    return {
      element: el,
      distance: Math.hypot(elCenter.x - center.x, elCenter.y - center.y)
    };
  });

  // Sort by distance and group into rings
  distances.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);

  const ringSize = Math.ceil(elements.length / 4);
  const rings = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    rings.push(
      distances
        .slice(i * ringSize, (i + 1) * ringSize)
        .map(d => d.element)
    );
  }

  return rings;
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
function CenterOutContainer({ children }) {
  const containerRef = useRef(null);

  return (
    <motion.div
      ref={containerRef}
      variants={{
        hidden: {},
        visible: {
          transition: {
            staggerChildren: 0.05,
            staggerDirection: 1
          }
        }
      }}
    >
      {React.Children.map(children, (child, index) => {
        // Calculate ring based on distance from center
        const ring = Math.floor(index / 3); // Simplified

        return (
          <motion.div
            variants={{
              hidden: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 },
              visible: {
                opacity: 1,
                scale: 1,
                transition: { delay: ring * 0.05 }
              }
            }}
          >
            {child}
          </motion.div>
        );
      })}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

### Gutenberg Diagram

For balanced layouts following natural visual flow.

```javascript
const gutenbergConfig = {
  zones: {
    'primary-optical': { position: 'top-left', weight: 1.0 },
    'strong-fallow': { position: 'top-right', weight: 0.6 },
    'weak-fallow': { position: 'bottom-left', weight: 0.3 },
    'terminal-area': { position: 'bottom-right', weight: 0.9 }
  },
  readingGravity: 'diagonal'
};

function applyGutenberg(elements) {
  const zones = categorizeGutenberg(elements);

  // Primary optical area first
  gsap.from(zones['primary-optical'], {
    opacity: 0,
    y: 20,
    duration: 0.4,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });

  // Strong fallow (often navigation)
  gsap.from(zones['strong-fallow'], {
    opacity: 0,
    y: 15,
    duration: 0.3,
    delay: 0.08,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });

  // Terminal area (CTA)
  gsap.from(zones['terminal-area'], {
    opacity: 0,
    scale: 0.95,
    duration: 0.35,
    delay: 0.15,
    ease: 'back.out(1.5)'
  });

  // Weak fallow last
  gsap.from(zones['weak-fallow'], {
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.25,
    delay: 0.2,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });
}
```

## Focus Anchors

Establish visual hierarchy with explicit priority.

```typescript
interface FocusAnchor {
  element: HTMLElement;
  level: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'tertiary' | 'ambient';
  attentionWeight: number;
  entrancePriority: number;
}

const focusLevels = {
  primary: { weight: 1.0, priority: 1, intensity: 0.8 },
  secondary: { weight: 0.6, priority: 2, intensity: 0.6 },
  tertiary: { weight: 0.3, priority: 3, intensity: 0.4 },
  ambient: { weight: 0.1, priority: 4, intensity: 0.2 }
};

function animateByHierarchy(anchors: FocusAnchor[]) {
  // Sort by priority
  anchors.sort((a, b) => a.entrancePriority - b.entrancePriority);

  let cumulativeDelay = 0;

  anchors.forEach(anchor => {
    const config = focusLevels[anchor.level];

    gsap.from(anchor.element, {
      opacity: 0,
      y: 20 * config.intensity,
      scale: 1 - (0.1 * config.intensity),
      duration: 0.3,
      delay: cumulativeDelay,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });

    cumulativeDelay += 0.08;
  });
}
```

## Attention Shifts

Transitioning focus between elements.

### Glide Shift

Smooth attention transfer.

```javascript
function glideShift(from, to) {
  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  // Defocus current
  tl.to(from, {
    opacity: 0.6,
    scale: 0.98,
    duration: 0.15
  });

  // Focus new
  tl.to(to, {
    opacity: 1,
    scale: 1,
    boxShadow: '0 0 0 3px rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.3)',
    duration: 0.2
  }, '-=0.1');

  return tl;
}
```

### Bridge Shift

Connected path between focus points.

```javascript
function bridgeShift(from, to) {
  const fromRect = from.getBoundingClientRect();
  const toRect = to.getBoundingClientRect();

  // Create visual connector
  const connector = createConnector(fromRect, toRect);

  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  // Draw connector
  tl.from(connector, {
    strokeDashoffset: connector.getTotalLength(),
    duration: 0.3,
    ease: 'power2.inOut'
  });

  // Shift focus
  tl.to(from, { opacity: 0.5, duration: 0.15 }, '-=0.15');
  tl.to(to, { opacity: 1, scale: 1.02, duration: 0.2 });

  // Fade connector
  tl.to(connector, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2 });

  return tl;
}
```

## Distraction Management

Reduce competing attention during focus moments.

```javascript
function suppressSecondary(primarySelector) {
  // Dim non-primary elements
  gsap.to('*:not(' + primarySelector + ')', {
    opacity: 0.6,
    filter: 'blur(1px)',
    duration: 0.2,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });

  // Enhance primary
  gsap.to(primarySelector, {
    opacity: 1,
    filter: 'blur(0)',
    boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
    duration: 0.3
  });
}

function restoreAll() {
  gsap.to('*', {
    opacity: 1,
    filter: 'blur(0)',
    boxShadow: 'none',
    duration: 0.3
  });
}
```

## Cultural Adaptations

### RTL (Right-to-Left) Languages

```javascript
function getPatternForDirection(pattern, direction) {
  if (direction === 'rtl') {
    const mirrorMap = {
      'f-pattern': {
        'top-left': 'top-right',
        'top-right': 'top-left',
        'mid-left': 'mid-right',
        'mid-right': 'mid-left'
      },
      'z-pattern': {
        'top-left': 'top-right',
        'top-right': 'top-left',
        'bottom-left': 'bottom-right',
        'bottom-right': 'bottom-left'
      }
    };

    return mirrorMap[pattern] || pattern;
  }

  return pattern;
}
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Choreography | Reduced |
|-------------------|---------|
| Staggered by pattern | Simultaneous fade |
| Attention shifts | Instant focus change |
| Bridge connectors | Skip |
| Hierarchy animation | Uniform timing |

```javascript
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
  '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
).matches;

if (prefersReducedMotion) {
  // Skip choreography, simple fade
  gsap.from(elements, {
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.2,
    stagger: 0 // No stagger
  });
}
```
````

BEGIN-DB-060
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/attention-choreography/references/f-pattern.md

````text
# F-Pattern Implementation

Detailed implementation guide for F-pattern reading choreography.

## Pattern Overview

The F-pattern describes how users scan text-heavy pages:

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║ ████████████████████████████████     ║ ← First horizontal sweep
║ ████████████████████                 ║
║ █████████████████████████            ║ ← Second horizontal sweep
║ ███████████████                      ║
║ █████                                ║ ← Vertical scan
║ ████                                 ║
║ ███                                  ║
║ ██                                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

## Animation Sequence

### Zone Priority

| Zone | Grid Position | Stagger Delay | Intensity |
|------|---------------|---------------|-----------|
| Top-left | rows 1-2, cols 1-2 | 0ms | 1.0 |
| Top-right | rows 1-2, cols 3-4 | 60ms | 0.85 |
| Mid-left | rows 3-4, cols 1-2 | 120ms | 0.7 |
| Mid-right | rows 3-4, cols 3-4 | 180ms | 0.55 |
| Bottom | rows 5+, col 1 | 240ms | 0.4 |

### Implementation

```javascript
const fPatternAnimation = {
  zones: [
    {
      name: 'top-left',
      selector: '[data-zone="top-left"]',
      delay: 0,
      animation: {
        from: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
        to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
        duration: 400,
        easing: 'emphasized-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      name: 'top-right',
      selector: '[data-zone="top-right"]',
      delay: 60,
      animation: {
        from: { opacity: 0, y: 15 },
        to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
        duration: 350,
        easing: 'standard-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      name: 'mid-left',
      selector: '[data-zone="mid-left"]',
      delay: 120,
      animation: {
        from: { opacity: 0, y: 15 },
        to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
        duration: 300,
        easing: 'standard-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      name: 'mid-right',
      selector: '[data-zone="mid-right"]',
      delay: 180,
      animation: {
        from: { opacity: 0, y: 10 },
        to: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
        duration: 250,
        easing: 'standard'
      }
    },
    {
      name: 'bottom',
      selector: '[data-zone="bottom"]',
      delay: 240,
      animation: {
        from: { opacity: 0 },
        to: { opacity: 1 },
        duration: 200,
        easing: 'standard'
      }
    }
  ]
};
```

### Zone Detection Algorithm

```javascript
function detectFPatternZone(element, container) {
  const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const elRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

  // Normalize to 0-1 range
  const normalX = (elRect.left - containerRect.left) / containerRect.width;
  const normalY = (elRect.top - containerRect.top) / containerRect.height;

  // Zone thresholds
  const horizontalMid = 0.5;
  const verticalThirds = [0.33, 0.66];

  // Determine zone
  if (normalY < verticalThirds[0]) {
    // Top third
    return normalX < horizontalMid ? 'top-left' : 'top-right';
  } else if (normalY < verticalThirds[1]) {
    // Middle third
    return normalX < horizontalMid ? 'mid-left' : 'mid-right';
  } else {
    // Bottom third - only left matters in F-pattern
    return 'bottom';
  }
}
```

### Content Type Adjustments

| Content Type | Adjustment |
|--------------|------------|
| Headlines | Prioritize in top-left |
| Navigation | Fast entrance in top-right |
| Body text | Subtle reveal in mid zones |
| Sidebar | De-prioritize in bottom |

```javascript
function adjustForContentType(element, baseConfig) {
  const contentType = element.dataset.contentType;

  const adjustments = {
    headline: { intensityBoost: 0.2, durationBoost: 1.2 },
    navigation: { speedBoost: 0.8, intensityBoost: 0 },
    body: { speedBoost: 1.1, intensityBoost: -0.1 },
    sidebar: { speedBoost: 1.2, intensityBoost: -0.2 }
  };

  const adj = adjustments[contentType] || {};

  return {
    ...baseConfig,
    duration: baseConfig.duration * (adj.speedBoost || 1),
    intensity: Math.max(0.2, baseConfig.intensity + (adj.intensityBoost || 0))
  };
}
```

## React Implementation

```tsx
import { motion, useAnimation } from 'framer-motion';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

const fPatternVariants = {
  hidden: {},
  visible: (custom: { zone: string; delay: number }) => ({
    transition: {
      delayChildren: custom.delay / 1000,
      staggerChildren: 0.03
    }
  })
};

const itemVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: { duration: 0.3, ease: [0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1] }
  }

function FPatternContainer({ children }) {
  return (
    <div className="f-pattern-grid">
      {/* Top-left zone */}
      <motion.div
        className="zone zone--top-left"
        custom={{ zone: 'top-left', delay: 0 }}
        variants={fPatternVariants}
        initial="hidden"
        animate="visible"
      >
        {children.filter(c => c.props['data-zone'] === 'top-left')}
      </motion.div>

      {/* Top-right zone */}
      <motion.div
        className="zone zone--top-right"
        custom={{ zone: 'top-right', delay: 60 }}
        variants={fPatternVariants}
        initial="hidden"
        animate="visible"
      >
        {children.filter(c => c.props['data-zone'] === 'top-right')}
      </motion.div>

      {/* Continue for other zones... */}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## GSAP Implementation

```javascript
function playFPatternEntrance() {
  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  // Top-left: Headlines, branding
  tl.from('[data-zone="top-left"]', {
    y: 20,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.4,
    stagger: 0.05,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });

  // Top-right: Navigation, secondary
  tl.from('[data-zone="top-right"]', {
    y: 15,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.35,
    stagger: 0.04,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  }, '-=0.25');

  // Mid-left: Main content start
  tl.from('[data-zone="mid-left"]', {
    y: 15,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.3,
    stagger: 0.04,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  }, '-=0.2');

  // Mid-right: Secondary content
  tl.from('[data-zone="mid-right"]', {
    y: 10,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.25,
    stagger: 0.03,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  }, '-=0.15');

  // Bottom: Tertiary content
  tl.from('[data-zone="bottom"]', {
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.2,
    stagger: 0.02,
    ease: 'power1.out'
  }, '-=0.1');

  return tl;
}
```

## Attention Decay Visualization

```
     1.0 ─┼─●──────────────────────────────────────────
         │  \
     0.8 ─┼───●────────────────────────────────────────
         │    \
     0.6 ─┼─────●──────────────────────────────────────
         │      \
     0.4 ─┼───────●────────────────────────────────────
         │         \
     0.2 ─┼──────────●─────────────────────────────────
         │
     0.0 ─┼────────────────────────────────────────────
          TL    TR    ML    MR    Bottom
```

## Best Practices

1. **Headlines in top-left** - Most attention
2. **CTAs in terminal position** - F-pattern end point
3. **Decrease animation intensity** down the page
4. **Keep top third fast** - First impression
5. **Subtle bottom animations** - Don't distract from content
````

````text
# Z-Pattern Implementation

Detailed implementation guide for Z-pattern reading choreography.

## Pattern Overview

The Z-pattern describes how users scan sparse, image-heavy pages:

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║ ●─────────────────────────────────●  ║
║  \                               /   ║
║   \                             /    ║
║    \                           /     ║
║     \                         /      ║
║      \         ●─────────────/       ║
║       \       /                      ║
║        \     /                       ║
║         \   /                        ║
║          \ /                         ║
║ ●─────────●──────────────────────●   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝

1. Top-left (Logo/Brand)
2. Top-right (Nav/Search)
3. Center (Hero content)
4. Bottom-left (Secondary info)
5. Bottom-right (CTA)
```

## Animation Sequence

### Zone Priority

| Zone | Purpose | Stagger Delay | Emphasis |
|------|---------|---------------|----------|
| Top-left | Brand identity | 0ms | High |
| Top-right | Navigation | 50ms | Medium |
| Center | Hero content | 120ms | Highest |
| Bottom-left | Supporting | 200ms | Low |
| Bottom-right | CTA | 280ms | High |

### Implementation

```javascript
const zPatternAnimation = {
  path: [
    {
      zone: 'top-left',
      delay: 0,
      intensity: 0.9,
      animation: {
        opacity: [0, 1],
        scale: [0.95, 1],
        duration: 350,
        easing: 'emphasized-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      zone: 'top-right',
      delay: 50,
      intensity: 0.7,
      animation: {
        opacity: [0, 1],
        x: [20, 0],
        duration: 300,
        easing: 'standard-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      zone: 'center',
      delay: 120,
      intensity: 1.0,
      animation: {
        opacity: [0, 1],
        scale: [0.9, 1],
        y: [30, 0],
        duration: 450,
        easing: 'emphasized-decelerate'
      }
    },
    {
      zone: 'bottom-left',
      delay: 200,
      intensity: 0.5,
      animation: {
        opacity: [0, 1],
        y: [15, 0],
        duration: 250,
        easing: 'standard'
      }
    },
    {
      zone: 'bottom-right',
      delay: 280,
      intensity: 0.95,
      animation: {
        opacity: [0, 1],
        scale: [0.9, 1],
        duration: 400,
        easing: 'back.out(1.7)'
      }
    }
  ]
};
```

### Zone Detection

```javascript
function detectZPatternZone(element, container) {
  const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
  const elRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();

  // Element center
  const centerX = (elRect.left + elRect.width/2 - containerRect.left) / containerRect.width;
  const centerY = (elRect.top + elRect.height/2 - containerRect.top) / containerRect.height;

  // Zone boundaries
  const topThreshold = 0.35;
  const bottomThreshold = 0.65;
  const leftThreshold = 0.35;
  const rightThreshold = 0.65;

  if (centerY < topThreshold) {
    return centerX < 0.5 ? 'top-left' : 'top-right';
  } else if (centerY > bottomThreshold) {
    return centerX < 0.5 ? 'bottom-left' : 'bottom-right';
  } else {
    return 'center';
  }
}
```

## Diagonal Flow Emphasis

Connect the Z-path with subtle visual connectors:

```javascript
function animateZPath() {
  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  // Optional: Draw Z-path connector
  tl.from('.z-path-svg path', {
    strokeDashoffset: 1000,
    duration: 1.2,
    ease: 'power2.inOut'
  });

  // Animate along path
  tl.to('.focus-indicator', {
    motionPath: {
      path: '.z-path-svg path',
      align: '.z-path-svg path',
      alignOrigin: [0.5, 0.5]
    },
    duration: 1.2,
    ease: 'power2.inOut'
  }, 0);

  return tl;
}
```

```
Zone Intensity Over Time:

     1.0 ─┼────●───────────●────────────────────●──
         │    │           │                    │
     0.8 ─┼────┤           │                    │──
         │    │           │                    │
     0.6 ─┼────┤───●───────│────────────────────│──
         │    │   │       │                    │
     0.4 ─┼────┤───┤───────│───────●────────────│──
         │    │   │       │       │            │
     0.2 ─┼────┤───┤───────┤───────┤────────────│──
         │    │   │       │       │            │
     0.0 ─┼────┴───┴───────┴───────┴────────────┴──
          0   TL  TR     Center   BL          BR
               50  120     200        280ms
```

## Best Practices

1. **Brand first** - Logo/identity in top-left
2. **Hero dominates** - Center zone gets most attention
3. **CTA last but strong** - Terminal position with emphasis
4. **Sparse layouts** - Z-pattern breaks down with dense content
5. **Clear diagonal** - Visual elements should guide the eye
````

BEGIN-DB-062

````text
---
name: attention
description: Attention-directing animations including pulsing indicators, notification badges, highlight effects, and focus guidance. Use when drawing user attention to specific elements, indicating updates, or guiding user focus through an interface.
---

# Attention

Animations that direct and capture user attention.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| WCAG 2.1 | w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding |
| Material Design | m3.material.io/foundations/interaction |

## Quick Reference

Uses tokens from: `tokens/motion.tokens.json`

### Attention Intensities

| Level | Duration | Use |
|-------|----------|-----|
| Subtle | 2s cycle | Passive indication |
| Moderate | 1s cycle | Active notification |
| Urgent | 0.5s cycle | Critical alert |

## Selection Guide

```
What attention level?
│
├── SUBTLE → Passive indication
│   ├── Gentle pulse → "something here"
│   ├── Soft glow → ambient highlight
│   └── Slow breathe → available action
│
├── MODERATE → Active notification
│   ├── Badge bounce → new content
│   ├── Pulse ring → update available
│   └── Shimmer → loading/processing
│
├── URGENT → Critical alert
│   ├── Rapid pulse → requires action
│   ├── Shake → error/warning
│   └── Flash → immediate attention
│
├── GUIDED → Focus direction
│   ├── Spotlight → isolated focus
│   ├── Arrow pulse → directional hint
│   └── Highlight sweep → scan guidance
│
└── CELEBRATION → Positive feedback
    ├── Confetti → achievement
    ├── Burst → success
    └── Sparkle → reward
```

## Patterns

### Pulse Indicator

Gentle pulsing attention.

**CSS:**
```css
.pulse {
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
}

/* Urgent pulse */
.pulse-urgent {
  animation: pulse-urgent 0.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse-urgent {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.02);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0);
  }
}
```

### Notification Badge

Bouncing badge indicator.

**CSS:**
```css
.badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  right: -8px;
  min-width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: #ef4444;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.badge.new {
  animation: badge-bounce 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

@keyframes badge-bounce {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.3);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* Continuous attention */
.badge.attention {
  animation: badge-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes badge-pulse {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.15);
  }
}
```

**JavaScript (Animate on count change):**
```javascript
function updateBadge(badge, count) {
  const currentCount = parseInt(badge.textContent) || 0;

  if (count > currentCount) {
    badge.textContent = count;
    badge.classList.remove('new');
    void badge.offsetWidth; // Trigger reflow
    badge.classList.add('new');
  } else {
    badge.textContent = count;
  }

  badge.style.display = count > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
}
```

      0 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
  }

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
function spotlight(element) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'spotlight-overlay';
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    overlay.classList.add('active');
    element.classList.add('spotlight-target');
  });

  return {
    dismiss: () => {
      overlay.classList.remove('active');
      element.classList.remove('spotlight-target');
      setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 300);
    }
  };
}
```

  transform: translateY(0);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* With progress bar */
.toast.auto-dismiss::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: #3b82f6;
  animation: toast-progress 5s linear forwards;
}

@keyframes toast-progress {
  from { width: 100%; }
  to { width: 0%; }
}

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Pulsing | Static highlight color |
| Bouncing badge | Instant appearance |
| Ring pulse | Static border |
| Shimmer | Solid gray |
| Arrow bounce | Static arrow |

**Implementation:**

    background: #e0e0e0;
  }
}

## Accessibility Considerations

- **Don't auto-play** indefinitely pulsing animations
- **Provide dismiss** for persistent attention elements
- **Limit frequency** of attention-grabbing effects
- **Color isn't enough** - combine with shape/motion
- **Respect focus** - don't animate focused elements excessively
````

````text
---
name: audio-reactive
description: Audio-reactive animations including beat synchronization, frequency visualization, and sound-driven motion. Use when creating music visualizers, audio-responsive UI, or rhythm-based animations. Provides tokens for frequency bands, sensitivity, and response mapping.
---

# Audio-Reactive

Animations driven by audio analysis and beat detection.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| Web Audio API | developer.mozilla.org/Web/API/Web_Audio_API |
| AnalyserNode | developer.mozilla.org/Web/API/AnalyserNode |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/audio.tokens.json`

### Frequency Bands

| Token | Range | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `frequency.bass` | 60-250Hz | Kick drums |
| `frequency.mid` | 500-2000Hz | Vocals |
| `frequency.high` | 4000-8000Hz | Cymbals |

### Sensitivity Levels

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `sensitivity.subtle` | 0.5 | Gentle response |
| `sensitivity.normal` | 1 | Standard |
| `sensitivity.high` | 2 | Dramatic |

### Beat Detection

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `beat.threshold.low` | 0.3 | Detect subtle beats |
| `beat.threshold.normal` | 0.5 | Standard detection |
| `beat.decay.fast` | 0.9 | Quick response |

## Selection Guide

```
What audio effect?
│
├── BEAT SYNC → Pulse on rhythm
│   ├── Kick drum → frequency.bass
│   ├── Snare → frequency.mid
│   └── Hi-hat → frequency.high
│
├── FREQUENCY VIZ → Spectrum display
│   ├── Simple bars → bar-count.low (16)
│   ├── Detailed → bar-count.medium (32)
│   └── High-res → bar-count.high (64)
│
├── RESPONSIVENESS
│   ├── Subtle → sensitivity.subtle + smoothing.heavy
│   ├── Normal → sensitivity.normal + smoothing.medium
│   └── Reactive → sensitivity.high + smoothing.light
│
└── ANIMATION TYPE
    ├── Scale → response.scale-min to scale-max
    ├── Opacity → response.opacity-min to opacity-max
    └── Position → response.position-range
```

## Patterns

### Audio Analyzer Setup

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
class AudioReactiveEngine {
  constructor(audioElement) {
    this.audioContext = new AudioContext();
    this.analyser = this.audioContext.createAnalyser();

    // Configure analyser
    this.analyser.fftSize = 256;
    this.analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.75; // {motion.audio.smoothing.medium}

    // Connect audio source
    const source = this.audioContext.createMediaElementSource(audioElement);
    source.connect(this.analyser);
    this.analyser.connect(this.audioContext.destination);

    // Data arrays
    this.frequencyData = new Uint8Array(this.analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    this.timeData = new Uint8Array(this.analyser.frequencyBinCount);
  }

  getFrequencyData() {
    this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(this.frequencyData);
    return this.frequencyData;
  }

  getAverageFrequency(startHz, endHz) {
    const nyquist = this.audioContext.sampleRate / 2;
    const startIndex = Math.floor((startHz / nyquist) * this.frequencyData.length);
    const endIndex = Math.floor((endHz / nyquist) * this.frequencyData.length);

    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++) {
      sum += this.frequencyData[i];
    }
    return sum / (endIndex - startIndex + 1) / 255;
  }

  getBass() {
    return this.getAverageFrequency(60, 250); // {motion.audio.frequency.bass}
  }

  getMids() {
    return this.getAverageFrequency(500, 2000); // {motion.audio.frequency.mid}
  }

  getHighs() {
    return this.getAverageFrequency(4000, 8000); // {motion.audio.frequency.high}
  }
}
```

### Beat Detection

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
class BeatDetector {
  constructor(analyser) {
    this.analyser = analyser;
    this.threshold = 0.5; // {motion.audio.beat.threshold.normal}
    this.decay = 0.95; // {motion.audio.beat.decay.medium}
    this.lastBeat = 0;
    this.energy = 0;
    this.onBeat = null;
  }

  update() {
    const data = this.analyser.getFrequencyData();

    // Calculate current energy (bass-heavy)
    let currentEnergy = 0;
    const bassEnd = Math.floor(data.length * 0.1); // Focus on bass
    for (let i = 0; i < bassEnd; i++) {
      currentEnergy += data[i] / 255;
    }
    currentEnergy /= bassEnd;

    // Beat detection
    if (currentEnergy > this.energy * (1 + this.threshold)) {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - this.lastBeat > 100) { // Debounce
        this.lastBeat = now;
        this.onBeat?.(currentEnergy);
      }
    }

    // Decay
    this.energy = Math.max(currentEnergy, this.energy * this.decay);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.update());
  }
}
```

### Scale on Beat

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const BeatScale = ({ audioEngine }) => {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    const beatDetector = new BeatDetector(audioEngine.analyser);

    beatDetector.onBeat = (energy) => {
      // Scale from 1 to 1.5 based on energy
      const newScale = 1 + (energy * 0.5); // {motion.audio.response.scale-max}
      setScale(newScale);

      // Decay back
      setTimeout(() => setScale(1), 100);
    };

    beatDetector.update();
  }, []);

  return (
    <motion.div
      animate={{ scale }}
      transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 500, damping: 15 }}
    />
  );
};
```

### Frequency Bars Visualizer

**Canvas:**
```javascript
class FrequencyBars {
  constructor(canvas, audioEngine) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.audio = audioEngine;
    this.barCount = 32; // {motion.audio.visualization.bar-count.medium}
    this.sensitivity = 1; // {motion.audio.sensitivity.normal}
  }

  render() {
    const { width, height } = this.canvas;
    const data = this.audio.getFrequencyData();

    this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const barWidth = width / this.barCount;
    const step = Math.floor(data.length / this.barCount);

    for (let i = 0; i < this.barCount; i++) {
      // Average samples for this bar
      let sum = 0;
      for (let j = 0; j < step; j++) {
        sum += data[i * step + j];
      }
      const value = (sum / step / 255) * this.sensitivity;

      const barHeight = value * height;
      const x = i * barWidth;
      const y = height - barHeight;

      // Color based on frequency
      const hue = (i / this.barCount) * 120; // Green to red
      this.ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 80%, 50%)`;

      this.ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth - 2, barHeight);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.render());
  }
}
```

### Audio-Reactive Position

**JavaScript + GSAP:**
```javascript
class AudioReactiveElement {
  constructor(element, audioEngine) {
    this.element = element;
    this.audio = audioEngine;
    this.positionRange = 50; // {motion.audio.response.position-range}
    this.rotationRange = 30; // {motion.audio.response.rotation-range}

    this.animate();
  }

  animate() {
    const bass = this.audio.getBass();
    const mids = this.audio.getMids();
    const highs = this.audio.getHighs();

    // Map audio to transforms
    const x = (bass - 0.5) * this.positionRange * 2;
    const y = (mids - 0.5) * this.positionRange;
    const rotation = (highs - 0.5) * this.rotationRange * 2;

    gsap.to(this.element, {
      x,
      y,
      rotation,
      duration: 0.1,
      ease: 'power1.out'
    });

    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.animate());
  }
}
```

### Waveform Visualization

**Canvas:**
```javascript
class Waveform {
  constructor(canvas, audioEngine) {
    this.canvas = canvas;
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.audio = audioEngine;
  }

  render() {
    const { width, height } = this.canvas;
    const data = this.audio.timeData;

    this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    this.ctx.beginPath();
    this.ctx.moveTo(0, height / 2);

    const sliceWidth = width / data.length;

    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      const value = data[i] / 255;
      const y = value * height;
      const x = i * sliceWidth;

      if (i === 0) {
        this.ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      } else {
        this.ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }

    this.ctx.strokeStyle = '#00ff88';
    this.ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    this.ctx.stroke();

    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.render());
  }
}
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Beat-synced animation | Static or gentle glow |
| Rapid frequency response | Slow, averaged response |
| Position displacement | Opacity changes only |

**Implementation:**
```javascript
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
  '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
).matches;

if (prefersReducedMotion) {
  // Use heavy smoothing and subtle sensitivity
  analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.9; // {motion.audio.smoothing.heavy}
  sensitivity = 0.5; // {motion.audio.sensitivity.subtle}

  // Use only opacity, not position
  useOpacityOnly = true;
}
```
````

## DB-064｜Motion Design Agent 子規則與 tokens｜skills/blur/SKILL.md

BEGIN-DB-064
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/blur/SKILL.md
此段為原始參考資料；按前部統一規則選用，命令和外部讀取要求不執行。

````text
---
name: blur
description: Blur animations including focus transitions, motion blur, depth of field, and tilt-shift effects. Use when creating focus pull transitions, adding motion blur to fast movements, implementing depth-based blur, or simulating camera lens effects.
---

# Blur

Blur effects for focus, motion, and depth simulation.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| CSS Filter | developer.mozilla.org/CSS/filter |
| CSS Backdrop Filter | developer.mozilla.org/CSS/backdrop-filter |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/blur.tokens.json`

### Blur Radius

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `none` | 0px | Sharp, in-focus |
| `subtle` | 2px | Slight softening |
| `light` | 4px | Noticeable softening |
| `medium` | 8px | Clear defocus |
| `strong` | 16px | Pronounced blur |
| `extreme` | 32px | Abstract softness |

### Focus Pull Duration

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `pull-duration-fast` | 200ms | Snap focus |
| `pull-duration-standard` | 400ms | Natural pace |
| `pull-duration-slow` | 800ms | Cinematic rack focus |

## Selection Guide

```
What type of blur?
│
├── FOCUS TRANSITION → Element coming into/out of focus
│   ├── Fast snap → 200ms
│   ├── Standard → 400ms
│   └── Cinematic → 800ms+
│
├── MOTION BLUR → Moving elements
│   ├── Subtle → distance-subtle (4px)
│   ├── Standard → distance-medium (12px)
│   └── Extreme → distance-extreme (48px)
│
├── DEPTH OF FIELD → Foreground/background separation
│   ├── Near blur → near-blur (8px)
│   └── Far blur → far-blur (4px)
│
├── TILT-SHIFT → Miniature effect
│   ├── Narrow band → focus-band-narrow (100px)
│   └── Wide band → focus-band-wide (400px)
│
└── BACKDROP → Background blur behind element
    ├── Subtle → light (4px)
    ├── Standard → medium (8px)
    └── Frosted glass → strong (16px)
```

## Patterns

### Focus Pull Transition

Animate blur to simulate camera focus change.

**CSS:**
```css
.focus-pull {
  transition: filter 400ms ease-out; /* {motion.blur.focus.pull-duration-standard} */
}

.focus-pull.out-of-focus {
  filter: blur(8px); /* {motion.blur.radius.medium} */
}

.focus-pull.in-focus {
  filter: blur(0px); /* {motion.blur.radius.none} */
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const focusVariants = {
  blurred: {
    filter: "blur(8px)", // {motion.blur.radius.medium}
    transition: { duration: 0.4 }
  },
  focused: {
    filter: "blur(0px)",
    transition: { duration: 0.4 }
  }
};

<motion.div
  variants={focusVariants}
  animate={isFocused ? "focused" : "blurred"}
/>
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
// Focus in
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "blur(0px)",
  duration: 0.4,
  ease: "power2.out"
});

// Focus out
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "blur(8px)",
  duration: 0.4,
  ease: "power2.out"
});
```

### Rack Focus (Two Elements)

Shift focus between foreground and background.

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
function rackFocus(foreground, background, duration = 0.8) {
  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  tl.to(foreground, {
    filter: "blur(8px)",
    duration: duration / 2,
    ease: "power2.inOut"
  }, 0)
  .to(background, {
    filter: "blur(0px)",
    duration: duration / 2,
    ease: "power2.inOut"
  }, duration / 4); // Slight overlap for smooth transition

  return tl;
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
function RackFocus({ focusTarget }) {
  return (
    <>
      <motion.div
        className="foreground"
        animate={{ filter: focusTarget === 'fg' ? 'blur(0px)' : 'blur(8px)' }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
      />
      <motion.div
        className="background"
        animate={{ filter: focusTarget === 'bg' ? 'blur(0px)' : 'blur(4px)' }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Motion Blur Effect

Blur in direction of movement.

**CSS (approximation with directional blur):**

.motion-blur-h {
  filter: blur(0px);
  text-shadow:
    -4px 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),
    -2px 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),
    2px 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),
    4px 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

/* Using SVG filter for true directional blur */

  filter: url(#motion-blur);
}
```

**SVG Filter:**
```html
<svg>
  <filter id="motion-blur">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="12,0" />
    <!-- 12px horizontal, 0px vertical -->
  </filter>
</svg>
```

**Framer Motion (animate blur during motion):**
```tsx
function MovingElement() {
  const x = useMotionValue(0);
  const blur = useTransform(
    useVelocity(x),
    [-1000, 0, 1000],
    [12, 0, 12] // More velocity = more blur
  );

  return (
    <motion.div
      style={{
        x,
        filter: useMotionTemplate`blur(${blur}px)`
      }}
      drag="x"
    />
  );
}
```

### Tilt-Shift Effect

Selective focus band for miniature effect.

**CSS (gradient mask + blur):**
```css
.tilt-shift-container {
  position: relative;
}

.tilt-shift-blur {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  filter: blur(16px);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    black 0%,
    transparent 30%,
    transparent 70%,
    black 100%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}
```

**Advanced Tilt-Shift:**
```javascript
function createTiltShift(container, options = {}) {
  const {
    focusPosition = 0.5, // 0-1, vertical position of focus band
    focusBandSize = 0.3, // 0-1, size of in-focus area
    blurAmount = 16      // px
  } = options;

  const top = (focusPosition - focusBandSize / 2) * 100;
  const bottom = (focusPosition + focusBandSize / 2) * 100;

  const blurLayer = document.createElement('div');
  blurLayer.style.cssText = `
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    filter: blur(${blurAmount}px);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      black 0%,
      black ${top}%,
      transparent ${top + 10}%,
      transparent ${bottom - 10}%,
      black ${bottom}%,
      black 100%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  `;

  container.style.position = 'relative';
  container.appendChild(blurLayer);

  return {
    updateFocus(newPosition) {
      // Animate focus band position
      gsap.to(blurLayer, {
        maskImage: `linear-gradient(...)`, // Updated gradient
        duration: 0.5
      });
    }
  };
}
```

### Depth-Based Blur

Blur based on z-depth in scene.

**CSS Custom Properties:**
```css
.depth-element {
  --z-depth: 0; /* 0 = in focus, negative = near, positive = far */
  filter: blur(calc(abs(var(--z-depth)) * 2px));
  transition: filter 200ms ease-out;
}

/* Example depth layers */
.layer-near { --z-depth: -3; } /* 6px blur */
.layer-focus { --z-depth: 0; } /* 0px blur */
.layer-mid { --z-depth: 2; }   /* 4px blur */
.layer-far { --z-depth: 4; }   /* 8px blur */
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
function DepthScene({ focalDistance }) {
  const layers = [
    { z: 100, content: "Near" },
    { z: 300, content: "Focus" },
    { z: 500, content: "Far" }
  ];

  return layers.map(layer => {
    const distance = Math.abs(layer.z - focalDistance);
    const blur = Math.min(distance / 50, 16); // Max 16px blur

    return (
      <motion.div
        key={layer.z}
        animate={{ filter: `blur(${blur}px)` }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
      >
        {layer.content}
      </motion.div>
    );
  });
}
```

### Radial/Zoom Blur

Blur radiating from center point.

**SVG Filter:**
```html
<svg>
  <filter id="radial-blur">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="0" result="blur1"/>
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="2" result="blur2"/>
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceGraphic" stdDeviation="4" result="blur3"/>

    <feImage href="data:image/svg+xml,..." result="gradient"/>

    <feComposite in="blur1" in2="gradient" operator="in" result="masked1"/>
    <!-- Complex compositing for radial effect -->
  </filter>
</svg>
```

**Canvas-based:**
```javascript
function radialBlur(ctx, centerX, centerY, maxBlur, samples = 10) {
  const canvas = ctx.canvas;
  const tempCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  tempCanvas.width = canvas.width;
  tempCanvas.height = canvas.height;
  const tempCtx = tempCanvas.getContext('2d');

  // Draw multiple scaled copies with offset
  for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
    const scale = 1 + (i / samples) * 0.1;
    const alpha = 1 / samples;

    tempCtx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    tempCtx.save();
    tempCtx.translate(centerX, centerY);
    tempCtx.scale(scale, scale);
    tempCtx.translate(-centerX, -centerY);
    tempCtx.drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    tempCtx.restore();
  }

  ctx.drawImage(tempCanvas, 0, 0);
}
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Focus pull animation | Instant blur change |
| Motion blur | No blur, or static slight blur |
| Animated tilt-shift | Static blur or none |
| Backdrop blur animation | Instant backdrop blur |

**Implementation:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .focus-pull {
    transition-duration: 0.01ms;
  }

  .motion-blur-h {
    filter: none;
    text-shadow: none;
  }

  .tilt-shift-blur {
    /* Keep static blur, just don't animate */
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Performance Considerations

1. **`filter: blur()` triggers GPU compositing** — generally performant
2. **`backdrop-filter` can be expensive** — limit to small areas
3. **Large blur radii** (32px+) may cause performance issues
4. **Animated blur** works best on simple elements
5. **Use `will-change: filter`** before animating

```css
.blur-animated {
  will-change: filter;
}

.blur-animated.animation-done {
  will-change: auto;
}
```

## Cross-References

- See `reveals/` for blur + reveal combinations
- See `opacity/` for blur + fade combinations
- See `depth/` for 3D depth-based blur
- See `camera/` for cinematic focus effects
- See `motion-blur/` for legacy motion blur tokens

## References

- No additional references needed for this skill

````

````text
name: brand-animation
description: Logo and brand identity animation patterns. Use when creating logo reveals, brand transitions, animated lockups, or defining motion style guides for brand consistency.
---

# Brand Animation

Motion patterns for logo reveals, brand identity, and consistent motion language.

## Logo Animation Patterns

### 1. Draw-On Reveal

```javascript
// SVG stroke animation
const logo = document.querySelector('.logo-path');
const length = logo.getTotalLength();

logo.style.strokeDasharray = length;
logo.style.strokeDashoffset = length;

// Animate
gsap.to(logo, {
  strokeDashoffset: 0,
  duration: 1.5,
  ease: 'power2.inOut'
});
```

**Best for:** Wordmarks, monoline logos, signature styles

### 2. Scale-In Reveal

```javascript
// Confident entrance from center
gsap.from('.logo', {
  scale: 0.8,
  opacity: 0,
  duration: 0.6,
  ease: 'back.out(1.5)'  // Slight overshoot
});
```

**Best for:** Symbol marks, compact logos, tech brands

### 3. Mask Reveal

```javascript
// Wipe/mask reveal
gsap.from('.logo-mask', {
  scaleX: 0,
  transformOrigin: 'left center',
  duration: 0.8,
  ease: 'power3.inOut'
});
```

**Best for:** Horizontal wordmarks, premium brands

### 4. Particle Assembly

```javascript
// Logo assembled from particles
particles.forEach((particle, i) => {
  gsap.to(particle, {
    x: finalPositions[i].x,
    y: finalPositions[i].y,
    duration: 1,
    delay: i * 0.02,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  });
});
```

**Best for:** Tech brands, innovative/modern identity

### 5. Morph Transition

```javascript
// Shape morphing with flubber
const interpolator = flubber.interpolate(
  startPath,
  logoPath
);

gsap.to({}, {
  duration: 1,
  onUpdate: function() {
    logoElement.setAttribute('d', interpolator(this.progress()));
  }
});
```

**Best for:** Multi-form logos, adaptive identity systems

## Lockup Animations

### Stacked Lockup

```javascript
// Logo + tagline stagger
const tl = gsap.timeline();

tl.from('.logo-symbol', {
    scale: 0.9,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.5,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  })
  .from('.logo-wordmark', {
    x: -20,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.4
  }, '-=0.2')
  .from('.tagline', {
    y: 10,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.3
  }, '-=0.1');
```

### Horizontal Lockup

```javascript
// Symbol leads, wordmark follows
const tl = gsap.timeline();

tl.from('.symbol', {
    scale: 0,
    rotation: -90,
    duration: 0.6,
    ease: 'back.out(1.2)'
  })
  .from('.wordmark', {
    x: 30,
    opacity: 0,
    duration: 0.4,
    ease: 'power2.out'
  }, '-=0.3');
```

## Brand Motion DNA

### Motion Attributes

| Attribute | Conservative | Balanced | Expressive |
|-----------|--------------|----------|------------|
| **Speed** | Measured | Responsive | Dynamic |
| **Easing** | Linear/Standard | Emphasized | Spring/Bounce |
| **Overshoot** | None | Subtle | Pronounced |
| **Secondary** | Minimal | Moderate | Rich |
| **Particles** | Never | Rare | Common |

### Brand Personality Mapping

```json
{
  "brand": "Example Corp",
  "personality": ["innovative", "trustworthy", "approachable"],

  "motionDNA": {
    "primary-easing": "emphasized-decelerate",
    "secondary-easing": "standard",
    "base-duration": 300,
    "stagger-interval": 50,
    "overshoot": 1.02,
    "spring-damping": 0.85,
    "particle-style": "subtle-sparkle",
    "color-transition": "smooth"
  },

  "forbidden": [
    "hard-bounce",
    "shake",
    "glitch",
    "rapid-flash"
  ]
}
```

## Animation Timing by Context

| Context | Duration | Easing | Notes |
|---------|----------|--------|-------|
| **Hero logo** | 1-2s | Dramatic | Full reveal experience |
| **Navigation** | 200-300ms | Standard | Quick, functional |
| **Loading** | 1-1.5s loop | Linear | Continuous, calm |
| **Favicon** | 500-800ms | Emphasized | Attention-grabbing |
| **Social** | 2-3s total | Expressive | Platform constraints |

## Platform Considerations

### Web

```css
/* Prefers reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .logo {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* Performance */
.logo {
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}
```

### Video/Broadcast

```javascript
// Longer, more dramatic timing
const videoTiming = {
  logoReveal: 1500,    // vs 600ms web
  holdDuration: 2000,  // Let it breathe
  exitDuration: 800
};
```

### Social Media

| Platform | Max Duration | Format | Safe Area |
|----------|--------------|--------|-----------|
| Instagram | 15s (story) | 9:16 | 10% padding |
| Twitter | 2:20 | 16:9 | Full bleed |
| LinkedIn | 10min | 1:1 or 16:9 | 5% padding |
| TikTok | 60s | 9:16 | 20% bottom |

## Responsive Logo Animation

```javascript
// Adapt animation to screen size
function getLogoAnimation() {
  const width = window.innerWidth;

  if (width < 768) {
    // Mobile: simpler, faster
    return {
      duration: 0.4,
      ease: 'power2.out',
      particles: false
    };
  } else if (width < 1200) {
    // Tablet: balanced
    return {
      duration: 0.6,
      ease: 'power3.out',
      particles: 'subtle'
    };
  } else {
    // Desktop: full experience
    return {
      duration: 0.8,
      ease: 'back.out(1.2)',
      particles: 'full'
    };
  }
}
```
````

````text
---
name: camera
description: Camera movement and cinematography animations including pan, tilt, dolly, zoom, shake, orbit, parallax, and tracking shots. Use when creating cinematic sequences, 3D scene navigation, virtual camera effects, or depth-based motion.
---

# Camera

Cinematographic camera movements and virtual camera effects.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| CSS Perspective | developer.mozilla.org/CSS/perspective |
| Three.js Camera | threejs.org/docs/#api/cameras/PerspectiveCamera |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/camera.tokens.json`

### Camera Movements

| Token | Duration | Use |
|-------|----------|-----|
| `pan.speed.slow` | 2000ms | Cinematic pan |
| `pan.speed.whip` | 150ms | Whip pan transition |
| `tilt.speed.normal` | 1000ms | Standard vertical |
| `dolly.speed.crash` | 200ms | Crash zoom |
| `zoom.speed.normal` | 800ms | Standard zoom |

### Shake Intensity

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `subtle` | 2px | Subtle handheld |
| `light` | 5px | Light shake |
| `medium` | 10px | Noticeable |
| `heavy` | 20px | Strong impact |
| `violent` | 40px | Extreme shake |

## Selection Guide

```
What camera movement?
│
├── PAN → Horizontal rotation
│   ├── Slow → cinematic reveal
│   ├── Normal → following action
│   └── Whip → transition/cut replacement
│
├── TILT → Vertical rotation
│   ├── Up → reveal height/power
│   └── Down → reveal ground/detail
│
├── DOLLY → Move toward/away
│   ├── In → intimacy, focus
│   ├── Out → reveal context
│   └── Crash → impact, emphasis
│
├── ZOOM → Change focal length
│   ├── In → attention, drama
│   ├── Out → disengage, broaden
│   └── With dolly → vertigo effect
│
├── ORBIT → Circle around subject
│   ├── Slow → product showcase
│   └── Fast → action, energy
│
├── TRACKING → Follow subject
│   ├── Smooth → steady follow
│   └── Lag → natural feel
│
├── CRANE → Vertical movement
│   ├── Up → reveal, establish
│   └── Down → descend into scene
│
├── SHAKE → Handheld/impact
│   ├── Subtle → documentary feel
│   ├── Medium → action sequence
│   └── Heavy → explosion, impact
│
└── PARALLAX → Depth layers
    └── Layers move at different speeds
```

## Patterns

### Pan Movement

Horizontal camera rotation.

**CSS:**

.scene {
  perspective: 1000px;
  perspective-origin: center center;
}

.camera-view {
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transition: transform 2s ease-out; /* {motion.camera.pan.speed.slow} */

  transform: rotateY(-15deg);
}

.camera-view.pan-right {
  transform: rotateY(15deg);
}
```

    animate={{ rotateY: panAngle }}
    transition={{
      duration: 2,    // {motion.camera.pan.speed.slow}
      ease: "easeOut"
    }}
  >
    {content}
  </motion.div>
</motion.div>
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
gsap.to('.camera-view', {
  rotateY: -15,
  duration: 2,       // {motion.camera.pan.speed.slow}
  ease: 'power2.out'
});
```

### Dolly Zoom / Vertigo Effect

Combined dolly and zoom for unsettling effect.

**JavaScript (Canvas/WebGL):**
```javascript
class VertigoEffect {
  constructor(initialFov, duration) {
    this.initialFov = initialFov;
    this.duration = duration;  // {motion.camera.vertigo.speed.normal}
    this.intensity = 1.5;      // {motion.camera.vertigo.intensity.moderate}
  }

  apply(camera, targetZ, progress) {
    // Dolly in while zooming out (or vice versa)
    // Keeps subject same size, but changes perspective
    const eased = this.easeInOut(progress);

    // Move camera forward
    camera.position.z = targetZ + (100 * (1 - eased));

    // Adjust FOV to compensate
    camera.fov = this.initialFov + (30 * eased);
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  easeInOut(t) {
    return t < 0.5
      ? 2 * t * t
      : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
  }
}
```

**Three.js:**
```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
import gsap from 'gsap';

function vertigoEffect(camera, duration = 1.5) {
  const initialFov = camera.fov;
  const initialZ = camera.position.z;

  const tl = gsap.timeline();

  tl.to(camera.position, {
    z: initialZ - 50,
    duration,
    ease: 'power2.inOut',
    onUpdate: () => {
      // Adjust FOV to maintain subject size
      const distanceRatio = initialZ / camera.position.z;
      camera.fov = initialFov * distanceRatio;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
  });

  return tl;
}
```

### Camera Shake

Impact or handheld shake effect.

**CSS:**
```css
@keyframes camera-shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
  10% { transform: translate(-5px, -5px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
  20% { transform: translate(5px, -3px) rotate(0.5deg); }
  30% { transform: translate(-3px, 5px) rotate(0deg); }
  40% { transform: translate(5px, 5px) rotate(0.5deg); }
  50% { transform: translate(-5px, 3px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
  60% { transform: translate(3px, -5px) rotate(0deg); }
  70% { transform: translate(-5px, 3px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
  80% { transform: translate(5px, -3px) rotate(0.5deg); }
  90% { transform: translate(-3px, -5px) rotate(0deg); }
}

.shake-light {
  animation: camera-shake 0.5s ease-in-out;
  /* Intensity: {motion.camera.shake.intensity.light} = 5px */
}

.shake-heavy {
  animation: camera-shake 0.3s ease-in-out;
  /* Scale up for {motion.camera.shake.intensity.heavy} = 20px */
  --shake-scale: 4;
}
```

**JavaScript (Procedural):**
```javascript
class CameraShake {
  constructor(intensity, frequency, decay) {
    this.intensity = intensity;  // {motion.camera.shake.intensity.medium}
    this.frequency = frequency;  // {motion.camera.shake.frequency.normal}
    this.decay = decay;          // {motion.camera.shake.decay.normal}
    this.time = 0;
    this.active = false;
  }

  trigger(duration) {
    this.time = 0;
    this.duration = duration;
    this.active = true;
  }

  update(deltaTime) {
    if (!this.active) return { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0 };

    this.time += deltaTime;

    if (this.time >= this.duration) {
      this.active = false;
      return { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0 };
    }

    const progress = this.time / this.duration;
    const currentIntensity = this.intensity * Math.pow(this.decay, progress * 10);

    // Perlin-like noise for natural shake
    const noiseX = Math.sin(this.time * this.frequency * 10) * Math.cos(this.time * 7);
    const noiseY = Math.cos(this.time * this.frequency * 8) * Math.sin(this.time * 11);
    const noiseRot = Math.sin(this.time * this.frequency * 6);

    return {
      x: noiseX * currentIntensity,
      y: noiseY * currentIntensity,
      rotation: noiseRot * currentIntensity * 0.1
    };
  }
}

// Usage
const shake = new CameraShake(10, 50, 0.95);
shake.trigger(500);

function animate() {
  const offset = shake.update(16.67);
  element.style.transform = `translate(${offset.x}px, ${offset.y}px) rotate(${offset.rotation}deg)`;
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
```

### Parallax Layers

  /* {motion.camera.parallax.layers.foreground} */

  /* {motion.camera.parallax.layers.midground} */
}

.layer-background {
  transform: translateZ(-50px) scale(1.05);
  /* {motion.camera.parallax.layers.background} */

.layer-distant {
  transform: translateZ(-100px) scale(1.1);
  /* {motion.camera.parallax.layers.distant} */
}
```

**JavaScript (Mouse-based):**
```javascript
class ParallaxScene {
  constructor(container) {
    this.container = container;
    this.layers = [
      { element: document.querySelector('.foreground'), depth: 1.5 },
      { element: document.querySelector('.midground'), depth: 1.0 },
      { element: document.querySelector('.background'), depth: 0.5 },
      { element: document.querySelector('.distant'), depth: 0.2 }
    ];

    this.intensity = 0.3; // {motion.camera.parallax.intensity.moderate}
    this.bind();
  }

  bind() {
    this.container.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = this.container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = (e.clientX - rect.left - rect.width / 2) / rect.width;
      const y = (e.clientY - rect.top - rect.height / 2) / rect.height;

      this.update(x, y);
    });
  }

  update(x, y) {
    this.layers.forEach(layer => {
      const moveX = x * 50 * layer.depth * this.intensity;
      const moveY = y * 50 * layer.depth * this.intensity;

      layer.element.style.transform = `translate(${moveX}px, ${moveY}px)`;
    });
  }
}
```

### Orbit Camera

Circular movement around a point.

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
class OrbitCamera {
  constructor(centerX, centerY, radius) {
    this.centerX = centerX;
    this.centerY = centerY;
    this.radius = radius;      // {motion.camera.orbit.radius.medium}
    this.angle = 0;
  }

  orbit(duration, arc = 360) {
    const startAngle = this.angle;
    const endAngle = startAngle + (arc * Math.PI / 180);
    const startTime = performance.now();
    const orbitDuration = duration; // {motion.camera.orbit.speed.normal}

    const animate = (currentTime) => {
      const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / orbitDuration, 1);
      const eased = this.easeInOut(progress);

      this.angle = startAngle + (endAngle - startAngle) * eased;

      const x = this.centerX + Math.cos(this.angle) * this.radius;
      const y = this.centerY + Math.sin(this.angle) * this.radius;

      this.updateCamera(x, y, this.angle);

      if (progress < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  updateCamera(x, y, angle) {
    // Apply to camera or viewport
    const view = document.querySelector('.camera-view');
    view.style.transform = `
      translate(${-x}px, ${-y}px)
      rotate(${-angle}rad)
    `;
  }

  easeInOut(t) {
    return t < 0.5
      ? 2 * t * t
      : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
  }
}
```

### Tracking Shot

Camera following a moving subject.

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
class TrackingCamera {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.target = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.position = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.smoothing = options.smoothing || 0.1; // {motion.camera.tracking.smoothing.light}
    this.lag = options.lag || 1.0;             // {motion.camera.tracking.speed.match}
  }

  setTarget(x, y) {
    this.target.x = x;
    this.target.y = y;
  }

  update() {
    // Smooth following with lag
    const dx = (this.target.x - this.position.x) * this.lag;
    const dy = (this.target.y - this.position.y) * this.lag;

    this.position.x += dx * this.smoothing;
    this.position.y += dy * this.smoothing;

    return {
      x: this.position.x,
      y: this.position.y
    };
  }

  apply(viewport) {
    const pos = this.update();
    viewport.style.transform = `translate(${-pos.x}px, ${-pos.y}px)`;
  }
}

// Usage with animation loop
const camera = new TrackingCamera({ smoothing: 0.1, lag: 0.8 });
const subject = document.querySelector('.subject');
const viewport = document.querySelector('.viewport');

function animate() {
  const rect = subject.getBoundingClientRect();
  camera.setTarget(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2);
  camera.apply(viewport);
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
```

### Focus Pull

Depth of field rack focus.

**CSS (Simulated):**
```css
.scene {
  position: relative;
}

.layer {
  transition: filter 600ms ease-out;
  /* {motion.camera.focus.pull-speed.normal} */

/* Focus on foreground */

  filter: blur(0);

```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const FocusPull = ({ focusLayer }) => {
  const layers = ['foreground', 'midground', 'background'];

  return (
    <div className="scene">
      {layers.map(layer => (
        <motion.div
          key={layer}
          className={layer}
          animate={{
            filter: layer === focusLayer ? 'blur(0px)' : 'blur(8px)'
          }}
          transition={{
            duration: 0.6, // {motion.camera.focus.pull-speed.normal}
            ease: 'easeOut'
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Camera pan/tilt | Instant cut or disabled |
| Shake | Disabled |
| Parallax | Reduced or disabled |
| Vertigo effect | Disabled |
| Orbit | Static or very slow |

**Implementation:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .camera-view {
    transition: none;
  }

  .parallax-layer {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .shake-light,
  .shake-heavy {
    animation: none;
  }

  .crane-up,
  .crane-down {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

```javascript
const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia(
  '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
).matches;

if (prefersReducedMotion) {
  // Disable camera shake
  cameraShake.intensity = 0;

  // Disable parallax
  parallaxScene.intensity = 0;

  // Use instant transitions
  orbitCamera.duration = 0;
}
```
````

````text
# Camera Movements Reference

Comprehensive cinematography techniques for virtual camera systems.

## Movement Types

### Pan (Horizontal Rotation)

Camera rotates on its vertical axis.

```javascript
class PanCamera {
  constructor(fov = 60) {
    this.rotation = 0; // degrees
    this.fov = fov;
  }

  pan(degrees, duration, ease = 'easeOut') {
    const startRotation = this.rotation;
    const endRotation = startRotation + degrees;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const animate = (time) => {
      const elapsed = time - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      const eased = this.ease(progress, ease);

      this.rotation = startRotation + (endRotation - startRotation) * eased;
      this.applyTransform();

      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  applyTransform() {
    document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
      `perspective(1000px) rotateY(${-this.rotation}deg)`;
  }

  ease(t, type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'easeIn': return t * t;
      case 'easeOut': return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 2);
      case 'easeInOut': return t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
      default: return t;
    }
  }
}
```

### Tilt (Vertical Rotation)

Camera rotates on its horizontal axis.

```javascript
class TiltCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.tilt = 0; // degrees
  }

  tiltTo(degrees, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this, {
      tilt: degrees,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: () => this.applyTransform()
    });
  }

  applyTransform() {
    document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
      `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${this.tilt}deg)`;
  }
}

// Dutch angle (roll) variant
class DutchAngle {
  constructor() {
    this.roll = 0;
  }

  dutch(degrees, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this, {
      roll: degrees,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.inOut',
      onUpdate: () => {
        document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
          `rotate(${this.roll}deg)`;
      }
    });
  }
}
```

### Dolly (Forward/Back Movement)

Camera moves along its z-axis.

```javascript
class DollyCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.z = 0;
  }

  dollyIn(distance, duration) {
    return this.dolly(distance, duration);
  }

  dollyOut(distance, duration) {
    return this.dolly(-distance, duration);
  }

  dolly(distance, duration) {
    const startZ = this.z;
    const endZ = startZ + distance;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const animate = (time) => {
      const progress = Math.min((time - startTime) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);

      this.z = startZ + (endZ - startZ) * eased;
      this.applyTransform();

      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  applyTransform() {
    // Using scale to simulate dolly in 2D
    const scale = 1 + (this.z / 500);
    document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;
  }
}
```

### Truck (Lateral Movement)

Camera moves sideways (left/right).

```javascript
class TruckCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.x = 0;
  }

  truck(distance, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this, {
      x: this.x + distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: () => {
        document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
          `translateX(${-this.x}px)`;
      }
    });
  }

  truckLeft(distance, duration) {
    return this.truck(-distance, duration);
  }

  truckRight(distance, duration) {
    return this.truck(distance, duration);
  }
}
```

### Pedestal (Vertical Movement)

Camera moves up/down without tilting.

```javascript
class PedestalCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.y = 0;
  }

  pedestal(distance, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this, {
      y: this.y + distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.inOut',
      onUpdate: () => {
        document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
          `translateY(${-this.y}px)`;
      }
    });
  }

  pedestalUp(distance, duration) {
    return this.pedestal(-distance, duration);
  }

  pedestalDown(distance, duration) {
    return this.pedestal(distance, duration);
  }
}
````
