````text
## Combined Movements

### Crane Shot

Combined pedestal + tilt (like a crane arm).

```javascript
class CraneCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.y = 0;
    this.tilt = 0;
  }

  craneUp(height, duration, options = {}) {
    const { tiltAngle = 10, ease = 'power2.out' } = options;

    return gsap.timeline()
      .to(this, {
        y: this.y - height,
        tilt: tiltAngle,
        duration: duration / 1000,
        ease,
        onUpdate: () => this.applyTransform()
      });
  }

  craneDown(height, duration, options = {}) {
    const { tiltAngle = -5, ease = 'power2.out' } = options;

    return gsap.timeline()
      .to(this, {
        y: this.y + height,
        tilt: tiltAngle,
        duration: duration / 1000,
        ease,
        onUpdate: () => this.applyTransform()
      });
  }

  applyTransform() {
    document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform = `
      translateY(${-this.y}px)
      perspective(1000px)
      rotateX(${this.tilt}deg)
    `;
  }
}
```

### Arc Shot

Camera moves in an arc around subject.

```javascript
class ArcCamera {
  constructor(centerX, centerY, radius) {
    this.center = { x: centerX, y: centerY };
    this.radius = radius;
    this.angle = 0;
  }

  arc(degrees, duration, options = {}) {
    const { direction = 'clockwise', ease = 'power2.inOut' } = options;
    const multiplier = direction === 'clockwise' ? 1 : -1;
    const endAngle = this.angle + (degrees * multiplier * Math.PI / 180);

    return gsap.to(this, {
      angle: endAngle,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease,
      onUpdate: () => {
        const x = this.center.x + Math.cos(this.angle) * this.radius;
        const y = this.center.y + Math.sin(this.angle) * this.radius;

        // Point camera at center
        const lookAngle = Math.atan2(
          this.center.y - y,
          this.center.x - x
        );

        document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform = `
          translate(${-x}px, ${-y}px)
          rotate(${lookAngle - Math.PI / 2}rad)
        `;
      }
    });
  }
}
```

### Steadicam / Gimbal

Smooth handheld-style following.

```javascript
class SteadicamCamera {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.position = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.velocity = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    this.target = { x: 0, y: 0 };

    this.stiffness = options.stiffness || 0.1;
    this.damping = options.damping || 0.8;
    this.breathingAmount = options.breathing || 2;
    this.breathingSpeed = options.breathingSpeed || 0.5;
  }

  follow(targetX, targetY) {
    this.target.x = targetX;
    this.target.y = targetY;
  }

  update() {
    // Spring physics for smooth following
    const dx = this.target.x - this.position.x;
    const dy = this.target.y - this.position.y;

    this.velocity.x += dx * this.stiffness;
    this.velocity.y += dy * this.stiffness;

    this.velocity.x *= this.damping;
    this.velocity.y *= this.damping;

    this.position.x += this.velocity.x;
    this.position.y += this.velocity.y;

    // Add subtle breathing motion
    const time = performance.now() / 1000;
    const breathX = Math.sin(time * this.breathingSpeed) * this.breathingAmount;
    const breathY = Math.cos(time * this.breathingSpeed * 0.7) * this.breathingAmount;

    return {
      x: this.position.x + breathX,
      y: this.position.y + breathY
    };
  }
}
```

## Special Techniques

### Vertigo / Dolly Zoom

Dolly in while zooming out (or reverse).

```javascript
class VertigoCamera {
  constructor(initialScale, targetDistance) {
    this.scale = initialScale;
    this.distance = 0;
    this.targetDistance = targetDistance;
  }

  /**
   * Creates the vertigo effect
   * As camera moves closer, zoom widens to keep subject same size
   * But perspective changes dramatically
   */
  execute(duration) {
    const startScale = this.scale;
    const startDistance = this.distance;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const animate = (time) => {
      const progress = Math.min((time - startTime) / duration, 1);
      const eased = this.easeInOutCubic(progress);

      this.distance = startDistance + (this.targetDistance - startDistance) * eased;

      // As distance decreases, scale increases to compensate
      // This keeps the subject the same apparent size
      const distanceFactor = 1 - (this.distance / this.targetDistance);
      this.scale = startScale * (1 + distanceFactor * 0.5);

      this.applyTransform();

      if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  applyTransform() {
    const scene = document.querySelector('.scene');
    scene.style.transform = `
      perspective(${1000 - this.distance * 2}px)
      scale(${this.scale})
      translateZ(${this.distance}px)
    `;
  }

  easeInOutCubic(t) {
    return t < 0.5
      ? 4 * t * t * t
      : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;
  }
}
```

### Whip Pan

Extremely fast pan used for transitions.

```javascript
class WhipPan {
  constructor() {
    this.element = document.querySelector('.scene');
  }

  /**
   * Whip pan transition between two states
   * @param {Function} onMidpoint - Called at blur peak to swap content
   */
  transition(direction, duration, onMidpoint) {
    const distance = direction === 'left' ? -100 : 100;
    const blurPeak = 20;

    const timeline = gsap.timeline();

    // First half: accelerate and blur
    timeline.to(this.element, {
      x: distance,
      rotation: direction === 'left' ? -5 : 5,
      filter: `blur(${blurPeak}px)`,
      duration: duration / 2000,
      ease: 'power2.in',
      onComplete: onMidpoint
    });

    // Second half: decelerate from opposite side
    timeline.set(this.element, {
      x: -distance
    });

    timeline.to(this.element, {
      x: 0,
      rotation: 0,
      filter: 'blur(0px)',
      duration: duration / 2000,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });

    return timeline;
  }
}
```

### Crash Zoom

Extremely fast dolly/zoom for dramatic effect.

```javascript
class CrashZoom {
  constructor() {
    this.scale = 1;
  }

  execute(targetScale, duration = 200) {
    return gsap.to(this, {
      scale: targetScale,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power4.out',
      onUpdate: () => {
        document.querySelector('.scene').style.transform =
          `scale(${this.scale})`;
      }
    });
  }

  // Crash in and hold
  crashIn(scale = 2, duration = 200) {
    return this.execute(scale, duration);
  }

  // Crash out from zoom
  crashOut(duration = 300) {
    return this.execute(1, duration);
  }
}
```

## Camera Controller

Unified camera system combining all movements.

```javascript
class CameraController {
  constructor(scene) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.state = {
      x: 0,
      y: 0,
      z: 0,
      rotateX: 0,
      rotateY: 0,
      rotateZ: 0,
      scale: 1,
      fov: 60
    };

    this.shake = {
      active: false,
      intensity: 0,
      decay: 0.95,
      offset: { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0 }
    };
  }

  // Movement methods
  pan(degrees, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      rotateY: this.state.rotateY + degrees,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  tilt(degrees, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      rotateX: this.state.rotateX + degrees,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  dolly(distance, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      z: this.state.z + distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  truck(distance, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      x: this.state.x + distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  pedestal(distance, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      y: this.state.y + distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  zoom(scale, duration) {
    return gsap.to(this.state, {
      scale: scale,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => this.render()
    });
  }

  // Shake effect
  triggerShake(intensity, duration) {
    this.shake.active = true;
    this.shake.intensity = intensity;

    setTimeout(() => {
      this.shake.active = false;
    }, duration);
  }

  updateShake() {
    if (!this.shake.active) {
      this.shake.offset = { x: 0, y: 0, rotation: 0 };
      return;
    }

    this.shake.offset = {
      x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * this.shake.intensity,
      y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * this.shake.intensity,
      rotation: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * this.shake.intensity * 0.05
    };

    this.shake.intensity *= this.shake.decay;
  }

  // Render current state
  render() {
    this.updateShake();

    const { x, y, z, rotateX, rotateY, rotateZ, scale } = this.state;
    const shake = this.shake.offset;

    this.scene.style.transform = `
      perspective(${1000 + z}px)
      translateX(${-x + shake.x}px)
      translateY(${-y + shake.y}px)
      rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
      rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
      rotateZ(${rotateZ + shake.rotation}deg)
      scale(${scale})
    `;
  }

  // Complex movements
  orbitAround(centerX, centerY, radius, degrees, duration) {
    const startAngle = Math.atan2(this.state.y - centerY, this.state.x - centerX);
    const endAngle = startAngle + (degrees * Math.PI / 180);

    return gsap.to(this, {
      angle: endAngle,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => {
        this.state.x = centerX + Math.cos(this.angle) * radius;
        this.state.y = centerY + Math.sin(this.angle) * radius;
        this.state.rotateY = -(this.angle * 180 / Math.PI) + 90;
        this.render();
      }
    }, { angle: startAngle });
  }
}
```

## Three.js Integration

Camera movements for 3D scenes.

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';
import gsap from 'gsap';

class ThreeCameraController {
  constructor(camera, target) {
    this.camera = camera;
    this.target = target || new THREE.Vector3();
  }

  pan(degrees, duration) {
    const radius = this.camera.position.distanceTo(this.target);
    const startAngle = Math.atan2(
      this.camera.position.x - this.target.x,
      this.camera.position.z - this.target.z
    );
    const endAngle = startAngle + (degrees * Math.PI / 180);

    return gsap.to({ angle: startAngle }, {
      angle: endAngle,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: function() {
        this.camera.position.x = this.target.x + Math.sin(this.angle) * radius;
        this.camera.position.z = this.target.z + Math.cos(this.angle) * radius;
        this.camera.lookAt(this.target);
      }.bind(this)
    });
  }

  dolly(distance, duration) {
    const direction = new THREE.Vector3()
      .subVectors(this.target, this.camera.position)
      .normalize();

    return gsap.to(this.camera.position, {
      x: this.camera.position.x + direction.x * distance,
      y: this.camera.position.y + direction.y * distance,
      z: this.camera.position.z + direction.z * distance,
      duration: duration / 1000,
      ease: 'power2.out'
    });
  }

  orbit(angleX, angleY, duration) {
    const spherical = new THREE.Spherical();
    spherical.setFromVector3(
      new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(this.camera.position, this.target)
    );

    return gsap.to(spherical, {
      phi: spherical.phi + (angleX * Math.PI / 180),
      theta: spherical.theta + (angleY * Math.PI / 180),
      duration: duration / 1000,
      onUpdate: () => {
        const pos = new THREE.Vector3().setFromSpherical(spherical);
        this.camera.position.copy(pos.add(this.target));
        this.camera.lookAt(this.target);
      }
    });
  }
}
```

## Performance Considerations

1. **Use transform instead of position** - GPU accelerated
2. **Avoid layout triggers** - Don't animate width/height
3. **Use will-change sparingly** - Only on actively animating elements
4. **Request animation frame** - Sync with display refresh
5. **Debounce mouse tracking** - Limit updates for parallax

```javascript
// Optimized render loop
class OptimizedCamera {
  constructor() {
    this.needsRender = false;
    this.startRenderLoop();
  }

  scheduleRender() {
    this.needsRender = true;
  }

  startRenderLoop() {
    const loop = () => {
      if (this.needsRender) {
        this.render();
        this.needsRender = false;
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
}
```
````

````text
---
name: character
description: Character animation including walk cycles, blink patterns, lip sync, facial expressions, and idle behaviors. Use when animating avatars, mascots, game characters, or illustrated figures. Provides tokens for timing, body mechanics, and expressive motion.
---

# Character

Animation patterns for characters and figures.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| Lottie Bodymovin | lottiefiles.com |
| Spine 2D | esotericsoftware.com |
| Rive | rive.app |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/character.tokens.json`

### Walk Cycle Timing

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `walk-cycle.duration.slow` | 1.5s | Leisurely |
| `walk-cycle.duration.normal` | 1s | Average |
| `walk-cycle.duration.fast` | 0.6s | Brisk |
| `walk-cycle.duration.run` | 0.4s | Running |

### Blink Timing

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `blink.duration` | 150ms | Close-open |
| `blink.interval-min` | 2s | Min between |
| `blink.interval-max` | 6s | Max between |

### Expression Transitions

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `expression.transition-quick` | 200ms | Fast change |
| `expression.transition-normal` | 400ms | Standard |
| `expression.transition-slow` | 800ms | Dramatic |

## Selection Guide

```
What character animation?
│
├── LOCOMOTION → Walk/run cycles
│   ├── Slow walk → duration.slow (1.5s cycle)
│   ├── Normal → duration.normal (1s cycle)
│   ├── Fast → duration.fast (0.6s cycle)
│   └── Run → duration.run (0.4s cycle)
│
├── FACIAL → Eyes and expression
│   ├── Blink → blink.duration (150ms)
│   ├── Quick expression → transition-quick
│   └── Dramatic → transition-slow
│
├── IDLE → Standing/waiting
│   ├── Breathing → idle.breathing-period (4s)
│   └── Sway → idle.sway-period (3s)
│
└── GESTURES → Actions
    ├── Wave → gesture.wave (600ms)
    ├── Nod → gesture.nod (400ms)
    └── Point → gesture.point (300ms)
```

## Patterns

### Eye Blink

**CSS:**
```css
@keyframes blink {
  0%, 45%, 55%, 100% {
    transform: scaleY(1);
  }
  50% {
    transform: scaleY(0.1); /* Almost closed */
  }
}

.eye {
  transform-origin: center;
  animation: blink 150ms ease-in-out; /* {motion.character.blink.duration} */
}
```

**JavaScript (Natural blink interval):**
```javascript
class BlinkController {
  constructor(eyeElement) {
    this.eye = eyeElement;
    this.minInterval = 2000; // {motion.character.blink.interval-min}
    this.maxInterval = 6000; // {motion.character.blink.interval-max}
    this.blinkDuration = 150; // {motion.character.blink.duration}

    this.scheduleBlink();
  }

  blink() {
    this.eye.style.transform = 'scaleY(0.1)';

    setTimeout(() => {
      this.eye.style.transform = 'scaleY(1)';
    }, this.blinkDuration / 2);

    this.scheduleBlink();
  }

  scheduleBlink() {
    const interval = this.minInterval +
      Math.random() * (this.maxInterval - this.minInterval);
    setTimeout(() => this.blink(), interval);
  }
}
```

### Walk Cycle

**CSS:**
```css
.character {
  animation: walk 1s steps(8) infinite; /* {motion.character.walk-cycle.duration.normal} */
}

/* Sprite sheet approach */
@keyframes walk {
  from { background-position: 0 0; }
  to { background-position: -800px 0; } /* 8 frames x 100px */
}

/* Vertical bob */
@keyframes walkBob {
  0%, 50%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  25% { transform: translateY(-5px); } /* {motion.character.walk-cycle.bob-amount.normal} */
  75% { transform: translateY(-5px); }
}

.character-body {
  animation: walkBob 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
```

**Framer Motion (Procedural):**
```tsx
const WalkCycle = ({ speed = 'normal' }) => {
  const durations = {
    slow: 1.5,
    normal: 1,
    fast: 0.6,
    run: 0.4
  };

  const duration = durations[speed];

  return (
    <motion.div
      animate={{
        y: [0, -5, 0, -5, 0], // {motion.character.walk-cycle.bob-amount.normal}
      }}
      transition={{
        duration,
        repeat: Infinity,
        times: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1],
        ease: 'easeInOut'
      }}
    >
      <motion.div
        animate={{
          rotate: [-15, 15, -15] // Arm swing
        }}
        transition={{
          duration,
          repeat: Infinity,
          ease: 'easeInOut'
        }}
        style={{ transformOrigin: 'top' }}
      >
        {/* Arm */}
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};
```

### Simple Lip Sync

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
const phonemes = {
  'A': 'open',
  'E': 'wide',
  'I': 'narrow',
  'O': 'round',
  'U': 'pucker',
  'M': 'closed',
  'rest': 'neutral'
};

class LipSync {
  constructor(mouthElement) {
    this.mouth = mouthElement;
    this.transitionTime = 50; // {motion.character.lip-sync.transition}
  }

  setPhoneme(phoneme) {
    const shape = phonemes[phoneme] || phonemes.rest;

    this.mouth.style.transition = `all ${this.transitionTime}ms ease-out`;
    this.mouth.className = `mouth mouth-${shape}`;
  }

  // Animate to audio timestamps
  animateToSpeech(phonemeTimeline) {
    phonemeTimeline.forEach(({ phoneme, time }) => {
      setTimeout(() => this.setPhoneme(phoneme), time);
    });
  }
}
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Walk cycle | Static pose or simple slide |
| Eye blink | Disabled or very infrequent |
| Breathing | Static or very subtle |
| Gestures | Instant or disabled |

**Implementation:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .character {
    animation: none;
  }

  .eye,
  .character-body {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```
````

## DB-069｜Motion Design Agent 子規則與 tokens｜skills/choice-resolution/SKILL.md

BEGIN-DB-069
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/choice-resolution/SKILL.md
此段為原始參考資料；按前部統一規則選用，命令和外部讀取要求不執行。

````text
---
name: choice-resolution
description: Unified resolution pipeline for merging parallel choice layers (recipe, emotion, brand, platform) into deterministic animation parameters. Use when generating animations with multiple conflicting inputs or when ensuring video/web timing consistency.
---

# Choice Resolution

Resolves conflicting animation parameters from multiple sources into a single, deterministic output. Transforms parallel choice systems into a sequential resolution pipeline.

## The Problem

Without unified resolution:
- Emotion multipliers stack without bounds (1.2 × 1.4 = 1.68 → exceeds M3's 600ms max)
- Brand "elegant" and emotion "playful" produce contradictory squash-stretch values
- Video timing rules exist separately from the main choice pipeline
- Same inputs can produce different outputs depending on evaluation order

## Resolution Pipeline

```
Recipe (base) → Emotion (modifier) → Brand (constraint) → Platform (adaptation) → Bounds → Accessibility (override)
```

Each layer has a specific role:

| Layer | Role | Operation |
|-------|------|-----------|
| Recipe | Base | Starting values (duration, easing, principles) |
| Emotion | Modifier | Multiplicative adjustments |
| Brand | Constraint | Upper bounds, feature restrictions |
| Platform | Adaptation | Platform-specific multipliers |
| Bounds | Clamp | Final M3-compliant range enforcement |
| Accessibility | Override | Reduced motion bypasses everything |

## Resolution Algorithm

```typescript
function resolveChoice(
  recipe: Recipe,
  emotions: WeightedEmotion[],
  brand: Brand,
  platform: Platform,
  context: Context
): ResolvedSpec {

  // 1. Start with recipe base
  let duration = recipe.duration;
  let easing = recipe.easing;
  let exaggeration = recipe.exaggeration ?? 1.0;
  let squashStretch = recipe.squashStretch ?? "none";
  let secondaryEffects = recipe.secondaryEffects ?? [];

  // 2. Blend emotions if multiple provided
  const blendedEmotion = blendEmotions(emotions);

  // 3. Apply blended emotion as modifier
  if (blendedEmotion) {
    duration *= blendedEmotion.durationMultiplier;
    easing = blendedEmotion.easing ?? easing;
    exaggeration *= blendedEmotion.exaggerationBoost ?? 1.0;
    squashStretch = blendedEmotion.squashStretch ?? squashStretch;
    secondaryEffects = mergeEffects(secondaryEffects, blendedEmotion.effects);
  }

  // 4. Apply brand as constraint
  if (brand) {
    exaggeration = Math.min(exaggeration, EXAGGERATION_LEVELS[brand.maxExaggeration]);
    if (!brand.allowsSquashStretch) {
      squashStretch = "none";
    }
    if (!brand.allowsParticles) {
      secondaryEffects = secondaryEffects.filter(e => e.type !== "particles");
    }
  }

  // 5. Apply platform adaptation
  duration *= platform.durationMultiplier;

  // 6. Clamp to bounds
  duration = clamp(duration, platform.minDuration, platform.maxDuration);
  exaggeration = clamp(exaggeration, 0, 1.25);

  // 7. Accessibility override
  if (context.reducedMotion) {
    return recipe.reducedMotion ?? DEFAULT_REDUCED_MOTION;
  }

  return { duration, easing, exaggeration, squashStretch, secondaryEffects };
}
```

## Emotion Blending

When multiple emotions are specified, blend using weighted average:

```typescript
function blendEmotions(emotions: WeightedEmotion[]): BlendedEmotion {
  if (emotions.length === 0) return null;
  if (emotions.length === 1) return emotions[0].emotion;

  // Normalize weights
  const totalWeight = emotions.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.weight, 0);
  const normalized = emotions.map(e => ({ ...e, weight: e.weight / totalWeight }));

  // Numeric values: weighted average
  const durationMultiplier = normalized.reduce(
    (sum, e) => sum + e.emotion.durationMultiplier * e.weight, 0
  );

  // Discrete values: use dominant emotion
  const dominant = normalized.reduce((a, b) => a.weight > b.weight ? a : b);
  const easing = dominant.emotion.easing;
  const spring = dominant.emotion.spring;

  // Effects: union if either enables
  const effects = mergeEffects(
    ...normalized.map(e => e.emotion.secondaryEffects)
  );

  return { durationMultiplier, easing, spring, effects };
}
```

## Merge Rules by Parameter

| Parameter | Merge Type | Description |
|-----------|------------|-------------|
| `duration` | multiply | Recipe × emotion × platform, then clamp |
| `easing` | override | Emotion > recipe (if specified) |
| `spring` | override | Emotion > recipe (if specified) |
| `exaggeration` | multiply-cap | Recipe × emotion, capped by brand |
| `squash-stretch` | minimum | More conservative of emotion/brand |
| `secondary-effects` | union-filter | Combine all, remove brand-forbidden |

## Platform Multipliers

| Platform | Duration | Max | Notes |
|----------|----------|-----|-------|
| Web | 1.0× | 600ms | M3 baseline |
| Video | 0.6× | 400ms | Faster for engagement |
| Mobile | 1.1× | 500ms | Touch feedback needs |
| Low-end | 0.8× | 400ms | Performance priority |

## Brand Constraints

| Brand | Max Exaggeration | Squash | Particles | Bounce |
|-------|------------------|--------|-----------|--------|
| elegant | subtle | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |
| professional | subtle | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ |
| friendly | moderate | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| playful | expressive | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| bold | expressive | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

## Worked Example

**Input:**
- Recipe: `success-notification` (duration: 300ms, spring-bouncy)
- Emotion: `celebratory` (1.2× duration, expressive exaggeration)
- Brand: `professional` (max subtle, no particles)
- Platform: `video` (0.6×)

**Resolution:**

```
1. Recipe base:      300ms, spring-bouncy, exaggeration=1.0
2. + Emotion:        300 × 1.2 = 360ms, expressive → 1.0
3. + Brand cap:      exaggeration capped to subtle (0.5), no particles
4. + Platform:       360 × 0.6 = 216ms
5. + Bounds:         216ms (within 50-400ms) ✓
6. Accessibility:    Not reduced motion, proceed

Final: 216ms, spring-bouncy, exaggeration=0.5, no particles
```

## Video-Specific Rules

When `platform === "video"`:

1. Apply 0.6× duration multiplier
2. Enforce 400ms maximum
3. Prefer immediate content start (no intro delay)
4. Use 3-frame minimum (100ms at 30fps)
5. Never auto-trigger celebrations

## Validation Checklist

After resolution, verify:

- [ ] Duration within platform bounds (50-600ms web, 50-400ms video)
- [ ] Exaggeration between 0 and 1.25
- [ ] No brand-forbidden features present
- [ ] Reduced motion respected if enabled
- [ ] Same inputs produce same outputs (deterministic)

## Related Skills

- `animation-recipes` - Recipe definitions
- `emotion-mapping` - Emotion parameter sets
- `platform-adaptation` - Platform-specific adjustments
- `accessibility` - Reduced motion handling

See `references/resolution-examples.md` for additional worked examples.

````

````text
# Choice Resolution Examples

Worked examples showing the full resolution pipeline from inputs to final animation parameters.

## Example 1: Video Payment Success

A payment confirmation animation for a video about a fintech app.

### Inputs

| Layer | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Recipe | `success-notification` |
| Emotions | `celebratory` (70%), `trustworthy` (30%) |
| Brand | `professional` |
| Platform | `video` |
| Context | `{ reducedMotion: false }` |

### Resolution Steps

**Step 1: Recipe Base**
```json
{
  "duration": 300,
  "easing": "spring-bouncy",
  "exaggeration": 1.0,
  "squash-stretch": "subtle",
  "follow-through": "medium",
  "secondary-effects": ["glow"]
}
```

**Step 2: Blend Emotions**
```
celebratory (0.7):
  - duration-multiplier: 1.2
  - exaggeration-boost: 1.0 (expressive)
  - particles: true

trustworthy (0.3):
  - duration-multiplier: 1.1
  - exaggeration-boost: 0.5 (subtle)
  - particles: false

Blended result:
  - duration-multiplier: (1.2 × 0.7) + (1.1 × 0.3) = 1.17
  - exaggeration: weighted toward celebratory
  - easing: spring-bouncy (from dominant celebratory)
  - particles: true (union - either enables)
```

**Step 3: Apply Emotion Modifier**
```json
{
  "duration": 300 × 1.17 = 351,
  "easing": "spring-bouncy",
  "exaggeration": 1.0 × 1.0 = 1.0,
  "squash-stretch": "subtle",
  "secondary-effects": ["glow", "particles"]
}
```

**Step 4: Apply Brand Constraints**
```
professional:
  - max-exaggeration: "subtle" (0.5)
  - allows-squash-stretch: false
  - allows-particles: false

After brand:
  - exaggeration: min(1.0, 0.5) = 0.5
  - squash-stretch: "none"
  - secondary-effects: ["glow"] (particles removed)
```

**Step 5: Apply Platform Adaptation**
```
video:
  - duration-multiplier: 0.6
  - max-duration: 400ms

duration: 351 × 0.6 = 210.6ms
```

**Step 6: Clamp to Bounds**
```
video bounds: 50-400ms
210.6ms → 211ms (rounded, within bounds) ✓
```

**Step 7: Accessibility Check**
```
reducedMotion: false → proceed with resolved values
```

### Final Output

```json
{
  "duration": 211,
  "easing": "spring-bouncy",
  "exaggeration": 0.5,
  "squash-stretch": "none",
  "follow-through": "medium",
  "secondary-effects": ["glow"]
}
```

---

## Example 2: Playful Button Press on Mobile

A button animation for a children's educational app.

### Inputs

| Layer | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Recipe | `button-press` |
| Emotion | `playful` |
| Brand | `playful` |
| Platform | `mobile` |
| Context | `{ reducedMotion: false }` |

### Resolution Steps

**Step 1: Recipe Base**
```json
{
  "duration": 200,
  "easing": "emphasized-decelerate",
  "exaggeration": 0.5,
  "squash-stretch": "subtle",
  "anticipation": "micro"
}
```

**Step 2: Apply Emotion (single, no blending)**
```
playful:
  - duration-multiplier: 1.1
  - exaggeration: "expressive" (1.0)
  - squash-stretch: "medium"
  - easing: "spring-bouncy"
```

**Step 3: After Emotion**
```json
{
  "duration": 200 × 1.1 = 220,
  "easing": "spring-bouncy",
  "exaggeration": 0.5 × 1.0 = 0.5,
  "squash-stretch": "medium",
  "anticipation": "small"
}
```

**Step 4: Apply Brand Constraints**
```
playful brand:
  - max-exaggeration: "expressive" (1.0)
  - allows-squash-stretch: true
  - allows-bounce: true

No constraints applied (all within limits)
```

**Step 5: Apply Platform**
```
mobile:
  - duration-multiplier: 1.1
  - max-duration: 500ms

duration: 220 × 1.1 = 242ms
```

**Step 6: Clamp**
```
242ms within 50-500ms ✓
```

### Final Output

```json
{
  "duration": 242,
  "easing": "spring-bouncy",
  "exaggeration": 0.5,
  "squash-stretch": "medium",
  "anticipation": "small"
}
```

## Example 4: Conflicting Emotions (Security Alert)

An alert that needs to feel urgent but trustworthy.

### Inputs

| Layer | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Recipe | `error-shake` |
| Emotions | `urgent` (60%), `trustworthy` (40%) |
| Brand | `professional` |
| Platform | `web` |

### Emotion Blending

```
urgent (0.6):
  - duration-multiplier: 0.8
  - exaggeration: "moderate" (0.75)
  - easing: "emphasized-accelerate"

trustworthy (0.4):
  - duration-multiplier: 1.1
  - exaggeration: "subtle" (0.5)
  - easing: "standard-decelerate"

Blended:
  - duration-multiplier: (0.8 × 0.6) + (1.1 × 0.4) = 0.92
  - easing: "emphasized-accelerate" (dominant emotion)
  - exaggeration: (0.75 × 0.6) + (0.5 × 0.4) = 0.65
```

### Final Output

```json
{
  "duration": 138,
  "easing": "emphasized-accelerate",
  "exaggeration": 0.5,
  "amplitude": 4,
  "iterations": 2
}
```

Note: Exaggeration was capped at 0.5 (subtle) by the professional brand constraint.

---

## Example 5: Duration Stacking Without Resolution (Anti-Pattern)

This example shows what happens WITHOUT unified resolution.

### Problematic Stacking

```
Recipe duration:     300ms
× celebratory:       × 1.2 = 360ms
× first-visit:       × 1.2 = 432ms
× welcoming:         × 1.2 = 518ms
× mysterious blend:  × 1.5 = 777ms ← EXCEEDS M3 MAX (600ms)
```

### With Unified Resolution

```
Recipe duration:     300ms
Blend emotions:      celebratory + welcoming → 1.15× multiplier
Apply once:          300 × 1.15 = 345ms
Context modifier:    first-visit → applied to exaggeration, not duration
Clamp to bounds:     345ms (within 50-600ms) ✓
```

The resolution system prevents unbounded stacking by:
1. Blending emotions before applying (single multiplier)
2. Moving context modifiers to non-duration parameters
3. Final bounds clamping as safety net

---

## Example 6: Video Intro Timing

Demonstrating video-specific timing rules.

### Input

| Layer | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Recipe | `hero-reveal` |
| Emotion | `welcoming` |
| Brand | `friendly` |
| Platform | `video` |

### Recipe Base

```json
{
  "sequence": [
    { "element": "background", "delay": 0, "type": "fade" },
    { "element": "headline", "delay": 100, "type": "slide-up" },
    { "element": "subhead", "delay": 200, "type": "slide-up" },
    { "element": "cta", "delay": 350, "type": "scale-in" }
  ],
  "total-duration": 350
}
```

### After Video Platform Adaptation

```
duration-multiplier: 0.6

New delays:
- background: 0ms (unchanged - immediate start)
- headline: 60ms
- subhead: 120ms
- cta: 210ms

New total: 210ms (within 400ms video max)
```

### Key Video Rules Applied

1. ✓ Content starts on first frame (no dead air)
2. ✓ Total duration under 400ms
3. ✓ Transitions compressed to ~3-6 frames each

---

## Common Blend Recipes

| Scenario | Blend | Result Character |
|----------|-------|------------------|
| Payment success | celebratory 70% + trustworthy 30% | Joyful but reliable |
| Security alert | urgent 60% + trustworthy 40% | Quick but reassuring |
| Kids app | playful 60% + calming 40% | Fun without overstimulation |
| Enterprise onboarding | professional 50% + welcoming 50% | Warm but credible |
| Game achievement | celebratory 80% + energetic 20% | Maximum excitement |
| Form error | frustrated 40% + trustworthy 60% | Corrective but supportive |

---

## Debugging Tips

When animations don't feel right:

1. **Too slow for video?** Check platform multiplier (should be 0.6×)
2. **Too bouncy for professional?** Brand constraint should cap squash-stretch
3. **Inconsistent outputs?** Check for unblended emotion stacking
4. **Particles appearing when forbidden?** Brand filter not applied after emotion union
5. **Exceeds M3 bounds?** Final clamp step may be missing
````

````text
---
name: cinematic
description: Film and video-style animations including letterboxing, fades to black, title cards, lower thirds, slow motion, Ken Burns, and film grain effects. Use when creating video intros, documentary-style content, or cinematic UI transitions.
---

# Cinematic

Film-style animation effects for video and cinematic content.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| Remotion | remotion.dev/docs |
| After Effects | adobe.com/products/aftereffects |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/cinematic.tokens.json`

### Fade Durations

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `to-black.fast` | 500ms | Quick fade out |
| `to-black.normal` | 1000ms | Standard fade |
| `to-black.dramatic` | 3000ms | Dramatic ending |
| `hold.normal` | 1000ms | Hold on black |

### Title Card

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `fade-in` | 800ms | Title appear |
| `hold` | 2000ms | Title visible |
| `fade-out` | 600ms | Title exit |

## Selection Guide

```
What cinematic effect?
│
├── LETTERBOX → Aspect ratio
│   ├── Subtle → 5% bars
│   ├── Standard → 2.35:1 ratio
│   └── Animated reveal
│
├── FADES → Scene transitions
│   ├── Fade to black → ending/transition
│   ├── Fade to white → flashback/dream
│   ├── Cross dissolve → scene blend
│   └── Dip to black → clear transition
│
├── TITLES → Text graphics
│   ├── Title card → centered text
│   ├── Lower third → name/info bar
│   └── Credits roll → scrolling text
│
├── SPEED → Timing effects
│   ├── Slow motion → dramatic emphasis
│   ├── Speed ramp → impact moment
│   └── Time freeze → pause
│
├── OVERLAYS → Visual effects
│   ├── Film grain → texture
│   ├── Vignette → focus
│   ├── Light leaks → warmth
│   └── Color grade → mood
│
└── CAMERA → Movement effects
    ├── Ken Burns → photo animation
    ├── Rack focus → depth
    └── Dolly zoom → vertigo
```

## Patterns

### Letterbox Animation

Cinematic aspect ratio bars.

**CSS:**
```css
.letterbox {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 0;
  background: black;
  z-index: 1000;
  transition: height 800ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  /* {motion.cinematic.letterbox.transition.normal} */
}

.letterbox-top {
  top: 0;
}

.letterbox-bottom {
  bottom: 0;
}

.cinematic-mode .letterbox {
  height: 12%; /* {motion.cinematic.letterbox.height.standard} */
}
```

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
function setLetterbox(height, duration = 800) {
  const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.letterbox');

  bars.forEach(bar => {
    bar.animate([
      { height: bar.style.height || '0' },
      { height: `${height}%` }
    ], {
      duration,
      easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)',
      fill: 'forwards'
    });
  });
}

// Cinematic mode on
setLetterbox(12);

// Back to full screen
setLetterbox(0);
```

### Fade to Black

Classic scene ending.

**CSS:**
```css
.fade-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: black;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 9999;
}

.fade-to-black .fade-overlay {
  animation: fade-black 1000ms ease-in forwards;
  /* {motion.cinematic.fade.to-black.normal} */
}

@keyframes fade-black {
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

/* With hold */
.fade-through-black .fade-overlay {
  animation:
    fade-black 1000ms ease-in forwards,
    hold 1000ms 1000ms forwards,
    fade-in 1000ms 2000ms ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes hold {
  from, to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes fade-in {
  to { opacity: 0; }

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
async function fadeToBlack(duration = 1000, hold = 1000) {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('.fade-overlay');

  // Fade out
  await overlay.animate([
    { opacity: 0 },
    { opacity: 1 }
  ], {
    duration,
    easing: 'ease-in',
    fill: 'forwards'
  }).finished;

  // Hold
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, hold));

  // Fade back in
  await overlay.animate([
    { opacity: 1 },
    { opacity: 0 }
  ], {
    duration: duration * 0.8,
    easing: 'ease-out',
    fill: 'forwards'
  }).finished;
}
```

function animateTitleCard(lines, container) {
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const element = document.createElement('div');
    element.textContent = line;
    element.style.opacity = 0;
    container.appendChild(element);

      { opacity: 1, transform: 'translateY(0)' }
    ], {
      duration: 800, // {motion.cinematic.title-card.fade-in}

}

### Ken Burns Effect

Pan and zoom on still images.

**CSS:**
```css
.ken-burns {
  overflow: hidden;

.ken-burns img {
  animation: ken-burns 8000ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  /* {motion.cinematic.ken-burns.duration.normal} */
}

@keyframes ken-burns {
  from {
    transform: scale(1) translate(0, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: scale(1.2) translate(-5%, -5%);
    /* {motion.cinematic.ken-burns.zoom-range.normal} */
  }
}
```

**JavaScript (Randomized):**
```javascript
function kenBurns(image, duration = 8000) {
  const zoomRange = 0.2; // {motion.cinematic.ken-burns.zoom-range.normal}
  const panRange = 10;

  // Random start and end states
  const startScale = 1 + Math.random() * zoomRange;
  const endScale = 1 + Math.random() * zoomRange;

  const startX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * panRange;
  const startY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * panRange;
  const endX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * panRange;
  const endY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * panRange;

  image.animate([
    { transform: `scale(${startScale}) translate(${startX}%, ${startY}%)` },
    { transform: `scale(${endScale}) translate(${endX}%, ${endY}%)` }
  ], {
    duration,
    easing: 'ease-in-out',
    fill: 'forwards'
  });
}
```

### Speed Ramp

Variable speed playback.

**JavaScript:**
```javascript
class SpeedRamp {
  constructor(timeline, options = {}) {
    this.timeline = timeline;
    this.normalSpeed = options.normalSpeed || 1;
    this.slowSpeed = options.slowSpeed || 0.25;
    // {motion.cinematic.slow-motion.dramatic}
    this.rampDuration = options.rampDuration || 500;
    // {motion.cinematic.speed-ramp.ramp-duration.normal}
  }

  slowDown() {
    return this.rampTo(this.slowSpeed);
  }

  speedUp() {
    return this.rampTo(this.normalSpeed);
  }

  rampTo(targetSpeed) {
    const startSpeed = this.timeline.playbackRate;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    return new Promise(resolve => {
      const update = (time) => {
        const progress = Math.min((time - startTime) / this.rampDuration, 1);
        const eased = this.easeInOut(progress);

        this.timeline.playbackRate = startSpeed + (targetSpeed - startSpeed) * eased;

        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      };

      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    });
  }

  easeInOut(t) {
    return t < 0.5
      ? 2 * t * t
      : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2;
  }
}
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Letterbox animation | Instant letterbox |
| Fade transitions | Faster fade or cut |
| Ken Burns | Static image |
| Film grain | Static or disabled |
| Speed ramps | Normal speed only |

**Implementation:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .letterbox {
    transition-duration: 0.01ms;
  }

  .ken-burns img {
    animation: none;
  }

  .film-grain::before {
    animation: none;
  }

  .fade-to-black .fade-overlay {
    animation-duration: 200ms;
  }
}
```
````

````text
---
name: code-generation
description: Generate production-ready animation code from specifications. Use when transforming animation specs into CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, or Remotion implementations with token references, reduced motion support, and performance optimizations.
---

# Code Generation

Generate production-ready animation code from orchestrated parameters. This skill transforms animation specifications into platform-specific implementations with proper token references, reduced motion support, and performance optimizations.

## Supported Platforms

| Platform | Output Format | Template |
|----------|---------------|----------|
| CSS | Keyframes + Transitions | `css-keyframes.template.txt`, `css-transition.template.txt` |
| GSAP | Timeline functions | `gsap-timeline.template.txt` |
| Framer Motion | Variants + hooks | `framer-motion-variant.template.txt` |
| Remotion | React components | `remotion-component.template.txt` |

## Generation Pipeline

```
Animation Specification
         |
         v
+------------------+
|  Token Resolver  | -> Map tokens to actual values
+--------+---------+
         |
         v
+------------------+
| Platform Adapter | -> Convert to platform format
+--------+---------+
         |
         v
+------------------+
| Template Filler  | -> Interpolate values
+--------+---------+
         |
         v
+------------------+
| Reduced Motion   | -> Generate a11y variant
+--------+---------+
         |
         v
    Output Code
```

## Token Resolution

### Duration Tokens

| Token | ms | seconds | frames@30fps |
|-------|---:|--------:|-------------:|
| `short-1` | 50 | 0.05 | 2 |
| `short-2` | 100 | 0.1 | 3 |
| `short-3` | 150 | 0.15 | 5 |
| `short-4` | 200 | 0.2 | 6 |
| `medium-1` | 250 | 0.25 | 8 |
| `medium-2` | 300 | 0.3 | 9 |
| `medium-3` | 350 | 0.35 | 11 |
| `medium-4` | 400 | 0.4 | 12 |
| `long-1` | 450 | 0.45 | 14 |
| `long-2` | 500 | 0.5 | 15 |

### Easing Tokens

| Token | CSS | GSAP |
|-------|-----|------|
| `standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` | `power2.out` |
| `emphasized-decelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)` | `power3.out` |
| `emphasized-accelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15)` | `power2.in` |
| `standard-decelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)` | `power2.out` |
| `linear` | `linear` | `none` |

### Spring Tokens

| Token | Damping | Stiffness | Mass |
|-------|--------:|----------:|-----:|
| `standard` | 15 | 150 | 1 |
| `snappy` | 25 | 300 | 0.5 |
| `bouncy` | 10 | 180 | 1 |
| `gentle` | 25 | 100 | 1.2 |
| `celebratory` | 8 | 180 | 1 |

## Platform Support Matrix

### Spring Physics

| Platform | Support | Implementation |
|----------|---------|----------------|
| CSS | Limited | `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` approximation |
| GSAP | Full | `elastic.out(1, 0.3)` |
| Framer Motion | Full | `{ type: 'spring', damping, stiffness, mass }` |
| Remotion | Full | `spring({ frame, fps, config })` |

### 3D Transform

| Feature | CSS | GSAP | Framer Motion | Remotion |
|---------|:---:|:----:|:-------------:|:--------:|
| `perspective` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `rotateX/Y/Z` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `translateZ` | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| `preserve-3d` | Yes | Yes | via style | Yes |

### Reduced Motion Detection

| Platform | Detection Method |
|----------|------------------|
| CSS | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` |
| GSAP | `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion)')` |
| Framer Motion | `useReducedMotion()` hook |
| Remotion | N/A (video) - option: reduced complexity export |

## Generation Workflow

### Input Specification

```typescript
interface AnimationSpec {
  name: string;
  recipe?: string;
  duration: DurationToken;
  easing: EasingToken | SpringToken;
  from: TransformState;
  to: TransformState;
  principles: string[];
  stagger?: number;
  platform: Platform;
}
```

### Output Example

**Input:** "Modal entrance animation with spring physics"

**Orchestrator Output:**
```typescript
{
  name: 'modal-entrance',
  recipe: 'modal-entrance',
  duration: 'medium-1',
  easing: 'spring-enter',
  from: { opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 16 },
  to: { opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 },
  principles: ['anticipation', 'staging'],
}
```

**Generated Outputs:**
- CSS: Keyframe + reduced motion
- GSAP: Timeline function + reduced motion check
- Framer Motion: Variants + hook + reduced variants
- Remotion: Component + spring + stagger variant

## Reduced Motion Strategy

1. **Replace transform animations** with opacity fade
2. **Shorten duration** to 100ms maximum
3. **Remove decorative** secondary animations
4. **Keep essential** state indicators (focus rings, color changes)

### Fallback Mapping

| Animation Type | Reduced Motion Fallback |
|----------------|------------------------|
| Entrance (fade + transform) | `opacity: 1; transform: none;` |
| Exit (fade out) | `opacity: 0;` |
| State change (hover, press) | `opacity: 0.9;` or instant state |
| Loading (shimmer, pulse) | `animation: none;` (static) |
| Error (shake) | `border-color: var(--error);` (no motion) |
| Celebration (particles) | `opacity: 1;` (skip particles) |

## Output Checklist

- [ ] Token references documented
- [ ] Platform-specific format correct
- [ ] Reduced motion variant included
- [ ] Performance optimizations (will-change, etc.)
- [ ] Type definitions (TypeScript)
- [ ] Usage examples in comments

## Related Skills

- `animation-recipes` - Input recipes for code generation
- `easing` - Easing token definitions
- `duration` - Duration token definitions
- `accessibility` - Reduced motion requirements
````

````text
  snappy: { damping: 25, stiffness: 300, mass: 0.5 },
  bouncy: { damping: 10, stiffness: 180, mass: 1 },
  gentle: { damping: 25, stiffness: 100, mass: 1.2 },

## Spring to GSAP Mapping

```javascript
// Convert spring tokens to GSAP elastic ease
function springToGsap(spring) {
  // Approximate spring with elastic ease
  // Lower damping = more oscillation
  const amplitude = Math.max(0.1, 1 - (spring.damping / 50));
  const period = 1 / (spring.stiffness / 100);

  return `elastic.out(${amplitude.toFixed(2)}, ${period.toFixed(2)})`;
}

// Examples:
// bouncy (damping: 10) -> elastic.out(0.8, 0.56)
// snappy (damping: 25) -> elastic.out(0.5, 0.33)
// gentle (damping: 25) -> power2.out (no bounce)
```

## Motion Blur for Remotion

```typescript
import { interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';

// Vector blur based on velocity
function useMotionBlur(velocity: number, intensity: 'subtle' | 'standard' | 'dramatic') {
  const blurMap = {
    subtle: { samples: 3, spread: 2 },
    standard: { samples: 5, spread: 4 },
    dramatic: { samples: 8, spread: 8 },
  };

  const config = blurMap[intensity];

  // Render multiple offset copies for motion blur effect
  return Array.from({ length: config.samples }, (_, i) => {
    const offset = ((i - config.samples / 2) / config.samples) * config.spread;
    const opacity = 1 / config.samples;
    return { offset, opacity };
  });
}
```

### GSAP Output

```javascript
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

const prefersReducedMotion =
  window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

export function slideUpFadeIn(targets, options = {}) {
  const { delay = 0, stagger = 0.05, onComplete } = options;

  if (prefersReducedMotion) {
    return gsap.to(targets, {
      opacity: 1,
      duration: 0.1,
      delay,
      onComplete,
    });
  }

  return gsap.from(targets, {
    opacity: 0,
    y: 20,
    duration: 0.25,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    stagger,
    delay,
    onComplete,
  });
}
```

### Framer Motion Output

```typescript
import type { Variants } from 'framer-motion';
import { useReducedMotion } from 'framer-motion';

export const modalVariants: Variants = {
  hidden: {
    opacity: 0,
    scale: 0.95,
    y: 16,
  },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1,
    scale: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: {
      duration: 0.25,
      ease: [0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1],
    },
  },
  exit: {
    opacity: 0,
    scale: 0.95,
    transition: {
      duration: 0.2,
      ease: [0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15],
    },
  },
};

export const modalReducedVariants: Variants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { duration: 0.1 } },
  exit: { opacity: 0, transition: { duration: 0.1 } },
};

export function useModalVariants() {
  const prefersReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();
  return prefersReducedMotion ? modalReducedVariants : modalVariants;
}
```

### Remotion Output

```typescript
import React from 'react';
import { useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, interpolate, Easing } from 'remotion';

interface SlideUpFadeInProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  delay?: number;
}

export const SlideUpFadeIn: React.FC<SlideUpFadeInProps> = ({
  children,
  delay = 0,
}) => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps } = useVideoConfig();

  const localFrame = Math.max(0, frame - delay);
  const duration = 8; // 250ms at 30fps

  const opacity = interpolate(
    localFrame,
    [0, duration],
    [0, 1],
    {
      easing: Easing.bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1),
      extrapolateRight: 'clamp',
    }
  );

  const translateY = interpolate(
    localFrame,
    [0, duration],
    [20, 0],
    {
      easing: Easing.bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1),
      extrapolateRight: 'clamp',
    }
  );

  return (
    <div style={{
      opacity,
      transform: `translateY(${translateY}px)`,
      willChange: 'transform, opacity',
    }}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Reduced Motion Generation

### Automatic Generation

```typescript
function generateReducedMotion(animation: AnimationSpec): ReducedMotionSpec {
  return {
    // Keep opacity, remove transforms
    properties: animation.properties.includes('opacity')
      ? ['opacity']
      : ['opacity'], // Always use opacity

    duration: Math.min(animation.duration, 100),

    easing: 'ease', // Simple easing

    // Instant state changes for complex animations
    instant: animation.complexity > 'simple',
  };
}
```

### Output Examples

**CSS:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .animation {
    animation: none;
    transition: opacity 100ms ease;
  }
}
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
if (prefersReducedMotion) {
  return gsap.to(target, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.1 });
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```typescript
const reducedVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { duration: 0.1 } },
};
```

**Remotion:**
```typescript
// Remotion videos typically aren't interactive, but can include
// reduced complexity versions for accessibility contexts
const opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 3], [0, 1], { extrapolateRight: 'clamp' });
// Skip transform animations
return <div style={{ opacity }}>{children}</div>;
```

## Generation Workflow

```typescript
function generateCode(spec: AnimationSpec): string {
  // 1. Resolve tokens
  const resolvedDuration = durationTokens[spec.duration];
  const resolvedEasing = easingTokens[spec.easing];

  // 2. Select template
  const template = templates[spec.platform];

  // 3. Build variables
  const variables = {
    ANIMATION_NAME: toKebabCase(spec.name),
    FUNCTION_NAME: toCamelCase(spec.name),
    COMPONENT_NAME: toPascalCase(spec.name),
    DURATION: resolvedDuration[platform.unit],
    DURATION_TOKEN: spec.duration,
    EASING_CSS: resolvedEasing.css,
    // ... more variables
  };

  // 4. Interpolate template
  const code = interpolateTemplate(template, variables);

  // 5. Add reduced motion
  const reducedCode = generateReducedMotion(spec, spec.platform);

  return code + '\n\n' + reducedCode;
}
```

````

````text
# Template Variables Reference

Complete reference for template interpolation variables used in code generation.

## Template Syntax

The template engine uses a Mustache-like syntax to generate platform-specific code from animation specifications.

### Variable Substitution

```
{{VARIABLE_NAME}}
```

### Conditional Blocks

```
{{#if CONDITION}}
// Code when true
{{/if}}

{{#if CONDITION}}
// Code when true
{{else}}
// Code when false
{{/if}}
```

## Naming Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{ANIMATION_NAME}}` | Kebab-case animation name | `modal-entrance` |
| `{{FUNCTION_NAME}}` | camelCase function name | `modalEntrance` |
| `{{COMPONENT_NAME}}` | PascalCase component name | `ModalEntrance` |
| `{{FILE_NAME}}` | File name (kebab-case) | `modal-entrance` |
| `{{CLASS_NAME}}` | CSS class name | `modal-entrance` |

## Duration Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{DURATION}}` | Numeric duration (ms) | `250` |
| `{{DURATION_S}}` | Duration in seconds | `0.25` |
| `{{DURATION_MS}}` | Duration in milliseconds | `250` |
| `{{DURATION_TOKEN}}` | Token reference | `medium-1` |
| `{{DURATION_FRAMES}}` | Duration in frames | `8` |
| `{{FPS}}` | Frames per second | `30` |
| `{{DELAY}}` | Animation delay (ms) | `100` |
| `{{REDUCED_DURATION}}` | Reduced motion duration | `100` |

## Easing Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{EASING_CSS}}` | CSS cubic-bezier | `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)` |
| `{{EASING_ARRAY}}` | Array format | `[0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1]` |
| `{{EASING_TOKEN}}` | Token name | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| `{{EASING_TYPE}}` | Type: `bezier` or `spring` | `bezier` |
| `{{SPRING_CONFIG}}` | Spring config name | `bouncy` |

## Transform Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{FROM_OPACITY}}` | Initial opacity | `0` |
| `{{TO_OPACITY}}` | Final opacity | `1` |
| `{{FROM_SCALE}}` | Initial scale | `0.95` |
| `{{TO_SCALE}}` | Final scale | `1` |
| `{{FROM_Y}}` | Initial translateY (px) | `16` |
| `{{TO_Y}}` | Final translateY (px) | `0` |
| `{{FROM_X}}` | Initial translateX (px) | `0` |
| `{{TO_X}}` | Final translateX (px) | `0` |
| `{{FROM_TRANSFORM}}` | Full transform string | `translateY(16px) scale(0.95)` |
| `{{TO_TRANSFORM}}` | Full transform string | `translateY(0) scale(1)` |
| `{{FROM_FILTER}}` | Initial filter | `blur(4px)` |
| `{{TO_FILTER}}` | Final filter | `blur(0)` |
| `{{EXIT_SCALE}}` | Exit animation scale | `0.95` |

## CSS-Specific Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{WILL_CHANGE}}` | Performance hint properties | `transform, opacity` |
| `{{FILL_MODE}}` | Animation fill mode | `forwards` |
| `{{ITERATION_COUNT}}` | Loop count | `infinite` |
| `{{KEYFRAME_50}}` | 50% keyframe styles | `transform: scale(1.1);` |
| `{{KEYFRAME_70}}` | 70% keyframe styles | `transform: scale(0.98);` |
| `{{TRANSITION_PROPERTIES}}` | Transition shorthand | `transform 250ms cubic-bezier(...)` |
| `{{STATE_SELECTOR}}` | State class suffix | `--active` |
| `{{BASE_STYLES}}` | Initial CSS properties | `opacity: 1;` |
| `{{TARGET_STYLES}}` | Target state CSS | `transform: translateY(-4px);` |
| `{{HOVER_STYLES}}` | Hover state CSS | `box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(...)` |
| `{{FOCUS_STYLES}}` | Focus state CSS | `outline: 2px solid blue;` |
| `{{ACTIVE_STYLES}}` | Active/press state CSS | `transform: scale(0.95);` |

## Reduced Motion Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{REDUCED_MOTION_STYLES}}` | Fallback CSS | `opacity: 1; transform: none;` |
| `{{REDUCED_TARGET_STYLES}}` | Reduced motion target | `opacity: 0.9;` |

## Metadata Variables

| Variable | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `{{STAGGER_MS}}` | Stagger delay in ms | `50` |
| `{{PRINCIPLES}}` | Applied Disney principles | `anticipation, follow-through` |
| `{{PRINCIPLE_REFS}}` | Token file references | `tokens/anticipation.tokens.json` |
| `{{RECIPE_REF}}` | Recipe reference | `modal-entrance` |
| `{{ANIMATION_DESCRIPTION}}` | Human-readable description | `Modal entrance animation` |
| `{{PROPERTIES}}` | Animated properties list | `transform, opacity, box-shadow` |

## Available Conditionals

| Conditional | True When |
|-------------|-----------|
| `HAS_STAGGER` | Animation includes staggered items |
| `HAS_EXIT` | Exit animation is defined |
| `HAS_TRANSFORM_Y` | translateY animation |
| `HAS_TRANSFORM_X` | translateX animation |
| `HAS_SCALE` | Scale animation |
| `HAS_ROTATION` | Rotation animation |
| `HAS_FILTER` | Filter animation (blur, brightness, etc.) |
| `USE_SPRING` | Using spring physics instead of bezier |
| `USE_INTERPOLATE` | Using interpolate (Remotion) |
| `HAS_CUSTOM_PROPS` | Custom props defined |
| `HOVER_STATE` | Hover state is defined |
| `FOCUS_STATE` | Focus state is defined |
| `ACTIVE_STATE` | Active/press state is defined |
| `KEYFRAME_50` | 50% keyframe is needed |
| `KEYFRAME_70` | 70% keyframe is needed |
| `FROM_OPACITY` | Opacity animation from value exists |
| `FROM_TRANSFORM` | Transform animation from value exists |
| `FROM_FILTER` | Filter animation from value exists |
| `DELAY` | Animation has a delay |
| `ITERATION_COUNT` | Animation loops |
| `PRINCIPLE_REFS` | Disney principle references exist |

## Variable Generation Rules

### `{{WILL_CHANGE}}` Generation

Based on animated properties, generate comma-separated list:
```
opacity animation -> "opacity"
transform animation -> "transform"
filter animation -> "filter"
multiple -> "transform, opacity"
```

### `{{REDUCED_MOTION_STYLES}}` Generation

Based on animation type:

| Animation Type | Reduced Motion Fallback |
|----------------|------------------------|
| Entrance (fade + transform) | `opacity: 1; transform: none;` |
| Exit (fade out) | `opacity: 0;` |
| State change (hover, press) | `opacity: 0.9;` or instant state |
| Loading (shimmer, pulse) | `animation: none;` (static) |
| Error (shake) | `border-color: var(--error);` (no motion) |
| Celebration (particles) | `opacity: 1;` (skip particles) |

### `{{PRINCIPLE_REFS}}` Generation

List token files for applied principles:
```
anticipation -> "tokens/anticipation.tokens.json"
squash-stretch -> "tokens/squash-stretch.tokens.json"
follow-through -> "tokens/follow-through.tokens.json"
```

## Template Examples

### Simple Variable Substitution

```
animation-name: {{ANIMATION_NAME}};
duration: {{DURATION}}ms;
```

### Conditional Blocks

```
{{#if HAS_SCALE}}
const scale = interpolate(frame, [0, duration], [{{FROM_SCALE}}, {{TO_SCALE}}]);
{{/if}}
```

### If-Else Blocks

```
{{#if USE_SPRING}}
transition: { type: 'spring', ...springConfigs['{{SPRING_CONFIG}}'] }
{{else}}
transition: { duration: {{DURATION_S}}, ease: {{EASING_ARRAY}} }
{{/if}}
```

## Adding New Templates

1. Create template file in `/v2/templates/`
2. Use `.template.txt` extension
3. Include all required variables
4. Add conditionals for optional features
5. Include usage examples as comments

````

BEGIN-DB-075
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/color/SKILL.md
此段為原始參考資料；按前部統一規則選用，命令和外部讀取要求不執行。

````text
---
name: color
description: Color animations including hue shifts, saturation changes, brightness transitions, and contrast adjustments. Use when implementing color morphing, theme transitions, mood effects, or attention-grabbing color pulses. Provides tokens for all color property animations.
---

# Color

Color property animations for dynamic visual effects.

## Standards Reference

| Standard | Documentation |
|----------|---------------|
| W3C DTCG | designtokens.org |
| CSS Filter | developer.mozilla.org/CSS/filter |
| CSS Color | developer.mozilla.org/CSS/color_value |
| Material Design 3 | m3.material.io/styles/color |

## Quick Reference

Load from: `tokens/color.tokens.json`

### Hue Shift Values

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `shift.subtle` | 10deg | Subtle color variation |
| `shift.small` | 30deg | Gentle color change |
| `shift.medium` | 60deg | Clear transition |
| `shift.complement` | 180deg | Opposite color |
| `shift.full` | 360deg | Complete cycle |

### Saturation Levels

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `saturation.grayscale` | 0 | Black and white |
| `saturation.muted` | 0.5 | Subdued colors |
| `saturation.normal` | 1 | Baseline |
| `saturation.vibrant` | 1.3 | Punchy colors |

### Brightness Levels

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `brightness.dark` | 0.5 | Shadowed |
| `brightness.normal` | 1 | Baseline |
| `brightness.bright` | 1.2 | Enhanced |
| `brightness.blown` | 2 | Overexposed |

### Contrast Levels

| Token | Value | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `contrast.flat` | 0.5 | Low dynamic range |
| `contrast.normal` | 1 | Baseline |
| `contrast.punchy` | 1.2 | Bold, crisp |
| `contrast.extreme` | 2 | Posterized |

## Selection Guide

```
What color effect?
│
├── HUE SHIFT → Change color entirely
│   ├── Subtle mood → shift.subtle (10deg)
│   ├── Noticeable → shift.small (30deg)
│   ├── Complement → shift.complement (180deg)
│   └── Rainbow cycle → shift.full (360deg)
│
├── SATURATION → Color intensity
│   ├── Grayscale → saturation.grayscale (0)
│   ├── Muted/disabled → saturation.muted (0.5)
│   ├── Normal → saturation.normal (1)
│   └── Vibrant/highlight → saturation.vibrant (1.3)
│
├── BRIGHTNESS → Light/dark
│   ├── Darken → brightness.dark (0.5)
│   ├── Normal → brightness.normal (1)
│   ├── Brighten → brightness.bright (1.2)
│   └── Flash/blown → brightness.blown (2)
│
├── CONTRAST → Dynamic range
│   ├── Flat/soft → contrast.flat (0.5)
│   ├── Normal → contrast.normal (1)
│   ├── Punchy → contrast.punchy (1.2)
│   └── Extreme → contrast.extreme (2)
│
└── TEMPERATURE → Warm/cool
    ├── Cool (blue tint) → temperature.cool (-20deg)
    ├── Neutral → temperature.neutral (0deg)
    └── Warm (orange tint) → temperature.warm (20deg)
```

## Patterns

### Hue Shift Animation

Animate color through hue rotation.

**CSS:**
```css
.hue-shift {
  filter: hue-rotate(0deg);
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out; /* {motion.color.duration.standard} */
}

.hue-shift:hover {
  filter: hue-rotate(30deg); /* {motion.color.shift.small} */
}

/* Rainbow cycle */
@keyframes rainbowCycle {
  from {
    filter: hue-rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    filter: hue-rotate(360deg); /* {motion.color.shift.full} */
  }
}

.rainbow {
  animation: rainbowCycle 5s linear infinite; /* {motion.color.cycle.period-medium} */
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
import { motion, useMotionValue, useTransform, animate } from 'framer-motion';

const HueShift = () => {
  const hue = useMotionValue(0);
  const filter = useTransform(hue, h => `hue-rotate(${h}deg)`);

  return (
    <motion.div
      style={{ filter }}
      whileHover={{
        filter: 'hue-rotate(30deg)', // {motion.color.shift.small}
        transition: { duration: 0.3 } // {motion.color.duration.standard}
      }}
    />
  );
};
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
// Hue shift on hover
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "hue-rotate(30deg)", // {motion.color.shift.small}
  duration: 0.3, // {motion.color.duration.standard}
  ease: "power2.out"
});

// Continuous rainbow cycle
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "hue-rotate(360deg)",
  duration: 5, // {motion.color.cycle.period-medium}
  ease: "none",
  repeat: -1
});
```

### Saturation Animation

Animate between color and grayscale.

**CSS:**
```css
.desaturate {
  filter: saturate(1); /* {motion.color.saturation.normal} */
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out;
}

.desaturate.disabled {
  filter: saturate(0.5); /* {motion.color.saturation.muted} */
}

.desaturate.grayscale {
  filter: saturate(0); /* {motion.color.saturation.grayscale} */
}

/* Reveal saturation on hover */
.grayscale-hover {
  filter: saturate(0);
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out;
}

.grayscale-hover:hover {
  filter: saturate(1.3); /* {motion.color.saturation.vibrant} */
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const SaturationReveal = () => (
  <motion.div
    initial={{ filter: 'saturate(0)' }} // grayscale
    whileHover={{
      filter: 'saturate(1.3)', // {motion.color.saturation.vibrant}
      transition: { duration: 0.3 }
    }}
  />
);
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
// Desaturate to grayscale
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "saturate(0)", // {motion.color.saturation.grayscale}
  duration: 0.3,
  ease: "power2.out"
});

// Enhance saturation
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "saturate(1.3)", // {motion.color.saturation.vibrant}
  duration: 0.3,
  ease: "power2.out"
});
```

### Brightness Flash

Quick brightness increase for attention.

**CSS:**
```css
@keyframes brightnessFlash {
  0%, 100% {
    filter: brightness(1); /* {motion.color.brightness.normal} */
  }
  50% {
    filter: brightness(2); /* {motion.color.brightness.blown} */
  }
}

.flash-brightness {
  animation: brightnessFlash 200ms ease-out; /* {motion.color.duration.quick} */
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const BrightnessFlash = () => (
  <motion.div
    animate={{
      filter: [
        'brightness(1)', // normal
        'brightness(2)', // {motion.color.brightness.blown}
        'brightness(1)'  // back to normal
      ]
    }}
    transition={{
      duration: 0.2, // {motion.color.duration.quick}
      times: [0, 0.5, 1]
    }}
  />
);
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
gsap.timeline()
  .to(element, {
    filter: "brightness(2)", // {motion.color.brightness.blown}
    duration: 0.1
  })
  .to(element, {
    filter: "brightness(1)", // {motion.color.brightness.normal}
    duration: 0.1
  });
```

### Theme Transition

Smooth transition between color schemes.

**CSS:**
```css
:root {
  --bg-color: #ffffff;
  --text-color: #1a1a1a;
  transition: background-color 500ms ease-out, color 500ms ease-out;
  /* {motion.color.duration.smooth} */
}

:root.dark-theme {
  --bg-color: #1a1a1a;
  --text-color: #ffffff;
}

body {
  background-color: var(--bg-color);
  color: var(--text-color);
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const ThemeTransition = ({ isDark }: { isDark: boolean }) => (
  <motion.div
    animate={{
      backgroundColor: isDark ? '#1a1a1a' : '#ffffff',
      color: isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#1a1a1a'
    }}
    transition={{
      duration: 0.5, // {motion.color.duration.smooth}
      ease: [0.2, 0, 0, 1] // M3 standard
    }}
  />
);
```

### Color Temperature Shift

Warm/cool color adjustment.

**CSS:**
```css
.warm-filter {
  filter: hue-rotate(20deg) saturate(1.1);
  /* {motion.color.temperature.warm} + slight saturation boost */
  transition: filter 500ms ease-out;
}

.cool-filter {
  filter: hue-rotate(-20deg) saturate(0.9);
  /* {motion.color.temperature.cool} + slight desaturation */
  transition: filter 500ms ease-out;
}
```

**GSAP:**
```javascript
// Warm shift (sunset feel)
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "hue-rotate(20deg) saturate(1.1)",
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: "power2.out"
});

// Cool shift (moonlight feel)
gsap.to(element, {
  filter: "hue-rotate(-20deg) saturate(0.9)",
  duration: 0.5,
  ease: "power2.out"
});
```

### Contrast Animation

Dynamic contrast adjustment.

**CSS:**
```css
.high-contrast {
  filter: contrast(1); /* {motion.color.contrast.normal} */
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out;
}

.high-contrast:hover {
  filter: contrast(1.2); /* {motion.color.contrast.punchy} */
}

/* Dramatic reveal */
@keyframes contrastReveal {
  from {
    filter: contrast(0.5); /* {motion.color.contrast.flat} */
  }
  to {
    filter: contrast(1.2); /* {motion.color.contrast.punchy} */
  }
}

.reveal-contrast {
  animation: contrastReveal 500ms ease-out forwards;
}
```

### Combined Color Effects

Multiple color properties animated together.

**CSS:**
```css
/* Vintage/sepia effect */
.vintage {
  filter:
    sepia(0.8) /* {motion.color.filter.sepia-intensity} */
    saturate(0.75) /* slightly desaturated */
    contrast(1.1); /* slightly punchy */
  transition: filter 500ms ease-out;
}

/* Dramatic mood */
.dramatic {
  filter:
    saturate(1.3) /* {motion.color.saturation.vibrant} */
    contrast(1.2) /* {motion.color.contrast.punchy} */
    brightness(0.9);
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out;
}

/* Faded/muted */
.faded {
  filter:
    saturate(0.5) /* {motion.color.saturation.muted} */
    contrast(0.75)
    brightness(1.1);
  transition: filter 300ms ease-out;
}
```

**Framer Motion:**
```tsx
const colorPresets = {
  normal: { filter: 'saturate(1) contrast(1) brightness(1)' },
  vintage: { filter: 'sepia(0.8) saturate(0.75) contrast(1.1)' },
  dramatic: { filter: 'saturate(1.3) contrast(1.2) brightness(0.9)' },
  faded: { filter: 'saturate(0.5) contrast(0.75) brightness(1.1)' }
};

<motion.div
  variants={colorPresets}
  animate="dramatic"
  transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
/>
```

## Remotion Implementation

```tsx
import { interpolate, useCurrentFrame } from 'remotion';

export const ColorTransition: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();

  // Hue cycle over 150 frames (5s at 30fps)
  const hue = interpolate(frame, [0, 150], [0, 360]);

  // Saturation pulse
  const saturation = interpolate(
    frame % 60,
    [0, 30, 60],
    [1, 1.3, 1] // {motion.color.saturation.normal} to vibrant and back
  );

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        filter: `hue-rotate(${hue}deg) saturate(${saturation})`,
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        background: 'linear-gradient(45deg, #ff6b6b, #4ecdc4)'
      }}
    />
  );
};
```

## Reduced Motion

For `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:

| Full Motion | Reduced Alternative |
|-------------|---------------------|
| Hue shift animation | Instant color change |
| Continuous rainbow | Static color or disabled |
| Saturation pulse | Static saturation level |
| Brightness flash | Subtle border highlight instead |

**Implementation:**
```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hue-shift,
  .desaturate,
  .flash-brightness {
    transition: none;
    animation: none;
  }

  .rainbow {
    animation: none;
    /* Pick a static pleasant color instead */
  }

  /* Use non-animated feedback */
  .flash-brightness:active {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-color);
  }
}
```

## Cross-References

- See `opacity/` for fade transitions combined with color
- See `blur/` for color + blur combinations
- See `stylization/` for color grade presets
- See `transitions/` for theme transition patterns
- See `compositing/` for blend mode effects
- See `cinematic/` for color grading in video

## References

- No additional references needed for this skill

````

## DB-076｜Motion Design Agent 子規則與 tokens｜skills/component-animations/SKILL.md

BEGIN-DB-076
來源：https://github.com/soilmass/motion-design-agent/blob/132c9d59231cf0fd91964ee433ba9e7e0b3bbf6d/skills/component-animations/SKILL.md

````text
---
name: component-animations
description: Complete animation specifications for UI component states. Use when implementing button, card, modal, toast, input, checkbox, switch, dropdown, or accordion animations with proper Disney principles and accessibility.
---

# Component Animations

Complete animation specifications for every UI component state. Reference this skill when implementing component-level animations with proper Disney principles, brand variations, and accessibility.

## Component Catalog

### Button

**Interaction States:**
- Idle -> Hover -> Press -> Release -> Idle
- Idle -> Focus -> Press -> Release -> Blur -> Idle
- Any -> Disabled
- Any -> Loading

| State | Transform | Duration | Easing |
|-------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Hover | `translateY(-2px)` | `short-3` | `standard-decelerate` |
| Press | `scale(0.95)` | `short-2` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Focus | Focus ring pulse | 1.5s | `ease-in-out` |
| Loading | Spinner rotation | 0.8s | `linear` |

**Brand Variations:**
- **Elegant:** No squash, subtle scale (0.98)
- **Playful:** Bounce with overshoot, scale 0.92 -> 1.05
- **Bold:** Quick snap, scale 0.95 -> 1.02

### Card

**Interaction States:**
- Idle -> Hover -> Press -> Idle
- Idle -> Selected
- Idle -> Dragging -> Drop

| State | Transform | Duration | Easing |
|-------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Hover | `translateY(-4px)` + shadow | `short-3` | `standard-decelerate` |
| Press | `scale(0.98)` | `short-2` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Entrance | fade + slide | `medium-1` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Dragging | `scale(1.02) rotate(2deg)` + shadow | - | - |

### Modal

**States:**
- Closed -> Opening -> Open -> Closing -> Closed

| State | Properties | Duration | Easing |
|-------|------------|----------|--------|
| Backdrop Open | opacity + blur | `medium-1` | `standard` |
| Content Open | opacity + scale + translateY | `medium-1` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Content Close | opacity + scale | `short-4` | `emphasized-accelerate` |

### Toast / Notification

**States:**
- Hidden -> Entering -> Visible -> Exiting -> Hidden

| Variant | Animation | Duration | Easing |
|---------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Success | slide + bounce + checkmark draw | 300ms | spring-bouncy |
| Error | slide + shake | 250ms + 150ms | emphasized-decelerate |
| Info | slide | 250ms | emphasized-decelerate |

### Input / Form Field

**States:**
- Idle -> Focus -> Filled -> Blur
- Any -> Error
- Any -> Success

| State | Animation | Duration | Easing |
|-------|-----------|----------|--------|
| Label Float | translateY + scale(0.85) | `short-3` | `standard-decelerate` |
| Focus Ring | border + shadow | `short-3` | `standard-decelerate` |
| Error | shake + border color | 150ms | `ease-out` |

### Checkbox

**States:**
- Unchecked -> Checked -> Unchecked

| Animation | Property | Duration | Easing |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| Check Draw | stroke-dashoffset | `short-3` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Box Fill | background-color | `short-3` | `standard` |
| Playful Bounce | scale 1.15 | `short-4` | spring |

### Switch / Toggle

**States:**
- Off -> On -> Off

| Animation | Property | Duration | Easing |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| Knob Slide | translateX | `short-4` | spring-bouncy |
| Track Color | background-color | `short-3` | `standard` |
| Playful Squash | width stretch | `short-2` | `standard` |

### Dropdown / Select

**States:**
- Closed -> Opening -> Open -> Closing -> Closed

| Animation | Property | Duration | Easing |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| Menu Open | scaleY + opacity | `short-4` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Item Stagger | opacity + translateY | 150ms | stagger 25ms |

### Accordion

**States:**
- Collapsed -> Expanding -> Expanded -> Collapsing -> Collapsed

| Animation | Property | Duration | Easing |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| Content Height | grid-template-rows | `medium-1` | `emphasized-decelerate` |
| Content Fade | opacity | `short-3` | `standard` |
| Icon Rotate | transform rotate(180deg) | `short-3` | `standard` |

### List Items

| Animation | Property | Duration | Easing |
|-----------|----------|----------|--------|
| Entrance Stagger | opacity + translateY | 250ms | stagger 50ms |
| Swipe Dismiss | translateX + opacity + rotate | 200ms | `emphasized-accelerate` |

## Accessibility Variants

All components must provide reduced motion alternatives:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  /* Disable all transform animations */
  .button, .card, .modal, .toast, .dropdown-menu {
    transition: opacity 100ms ease !important;
    transform: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }

  /* Keep essential state indicators */
  .button:hover, .card:hover {
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  .button:focus-visible, .input:focus {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-alpha);
  }

  /* Instant state changes */
  .checkbox:checked + .checkbox__box .checkbox__check {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Quick Reference Table

| Component | Enter | Exit | Hover | Press |
|-----------|-------|------|-------|-------|
| Button | - | - | `translateY(-2px)` | `scale(0.95)` |
| Card | fade+slide | fade | `translateY(-4px)` | `scale(0.98)` |
| Modal | scale+fade | scale+fade | - | - |
| Toast | slide+bounce | slide+fade | - | - |
| Input | - | - | - | - |
| Checkbox | draw | fade | - | - |
| Switch | spring | spring | - | - |
| Dropdown | scaleY | scaleY | - | - |
| Accordion | height | height | - | - |
| List Item | stagger | slide | background | - |

## Related Skills

- `animation-recipes` - Pre-built recipes for component animations
- `accessibility` - WCAG compliance for interactive components
- `easing` - Curve selection for component states
- `entrance-patterns` - Entrance animations for components
- `exit-patterns` - Exit animations for components

````

````text
# Component Animation Implementations

Detailed code examples for all component animations.

## Button

### Hover State

```css
/* CSS */
.button {
  transition: transform var(--duration-short-3) var(--ease-standard-decelerate),
              box-shadow var(--duration-short-3) var(--ease-standard-decelerate);
}

.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevation-1);
}

/* Elegant variation */
.button--elegant:hover {
  transform: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-elevation-1);
}

/* Playful variation */
.button--playful:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(1deg);
}

/* Bold variation */
.button--bold:hover {
  transform: scale(1.02);
}
```

### Press State

```css
/* CSS */
.button:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  transition-duration: var(--duration-short-2);
}

/* Playful with spring */
.button--playful:active {
  transform: scale(0.92);
  transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}
```

```typescript
// Framer Motion
const buttonVariants = {
  idle: { scale: 1, y: 0 },
  hover: { scale: 1, y: -2 },
  press: {
    scale: 0.95,
    transition: { duration: 0.2, ease: [0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1] }
  }
};

// Playful variation
const playfulButtonVariants = {
  hover: { scale: 1, y: -4, rotate: 1 },
  press: {
    scale: 0.92,
    transition: { type: 'spring', damping: 10, stiffness: 200 }
  }
};
```

### Focus State

```css
.button:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-alpha);
  animation: focus-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes focus-pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-alpha); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--color-primary-alpha-light); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .button:focus-visible {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

### Loading State

```css
.button--loading {
  position: relative;
  color: transparent;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.button--loading::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-top-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
```
````
